vulg: Paulus servus Christi Iesu vocatus apostolus segregatus in evangelium Dei
clem: Paulus, servus Jesu Christi, vocatus Apostolus, segregatus in Evangelium Dei,
tr: παυλος δουλος ιησου χριστου κλητος αποστολος αφωρισμενος εις ευαγγελιον θεου
kjv: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,

vulg: quod ante promiserat per prophetas suos in scripturis sanctis
clem: quod ante promiserat per prophetas suos in Scripturis sanctis
tr: ο προεπηγγειλατο δια των προφητων αυτου εν γραφαις αγιαις
kjv: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)

vulg: de Filio suo qui factus est ex semine David secundum carnem
clem: de Filio suo, qui factus est ei ex semine David secundum carnem,
tr: περι του υιου αυτου του γενομενου εκ σπερματος δαβιδ κατα σαρκα
kjv: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;

vulg: qui praedestinatus est Filius Dei in virtute secundum Spiritum sanctificationis ex resurrectione mortuorum Iesu Christi Domini nostri
clem: qui prædestinatus est Filius Dei in virtute secundum spiritum sanctificationis ex resurrectione mortuorum Jesu Christi Domini nostri:
tr: του ορισθεντος υιου θεου εν δυναμει κατα πνευμα αγιωσυνης εξ αναστασεως νεκρων ιησου χριστου του κυριου ημων
kjv: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:

vulg: per quem accepimus gratiam et apostolatum ad oboediendum fidei in omnibus gentibus pro nomine eius
clem: per quem accepimus gratiam, et apostolatum ad obediendum fidei in omnibus gentibus pro nomine ejus,
tr: δι ου ελαβομεν χαριν και αποστολην εις υπακοην πιστεως εν πασιν τοις εθνεσιν υπερ του ονοματος αυτου
kjv: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:

vulg: in quibus estis et vos vocati Iesu Christi
clem: in quibus estis et vos vocati Jesu Christi:
tr: εν οις εστε και υμεις κλητοι ιησου χριστου
kjv: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:

vulg: omnibus qui sunt Romae dilectis Dei vocatis sanctis gratia vobis et pax a Deo Patre nostro et Domino Iesu Christo
clem: omnibus qui sunt Romæ, dilectis Dei, vocatis sanctis. Gratia vobis, et pax a Deo Patre nostro, et Domino Jesu Christo.
tr: πασιν τοις ουσιν εν ρωμη αγαπητοις θεου κλητοις αγιοις χαρις υμιν και ειρηνη απο θεου πατρος ημων και κυριου ιησου χριστου
kjv: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.

vulg: primum quidem gratias ago Deo meo per Iesum Christum pro omnibus vobis quia fides vestra adnuntiatur in universo mundo
clem: Primum quidem gratias ago Deo meo per Jesum Christum pro omnibus vobis: quia fides vestra annuntiatur in universo mundo.
tr: πρωτον μεν ευχαριστω τω θεω μου δια ιησου χριστου υπερ παντων υμων οτι η πιστις υμων καταγγελλεται εν ολω τω κοσμω
kjv: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.

vulg: testis enim mihi est Deus cui servio in spiritu meo in evangelio Filii eius quod sine intermissione memoriam vestri facio
clem: Testis enim mihi est Deus, cui servio in spiritu meo in Evangelio Filii ejus, quod sine intermissione memoriam vestri facio
tr: μαρτυς γαρ μου εστιν ο θεος ω λατρευω εν τω πνευματι μου εν τω ευαγγελιω του υιου αυτου ως αδιαλειπτως μνειαν υμων ποιουμαι
kjv: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;

vulg: semper in orationibus meis obsecrans si quo modo tandem aliquando prosperum iter habeam in voluntate Dei veniendi ad vos
clem: semper in orationibus meis: obsecrans, si quomodo tandem aliquando prosperum iter habeam in voluntate Dei veniendi ad vos.
tr: παντοτε επι των προσευχων μου δεομενος ειπως ηδη ποτε ευοδωθησομαι εν τω θεληματι του θεου ελθειν προς υμας
kjv: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.

vulg: desidero enim videre vos ut aliquid inpertiar gratiae vobis spiritalis ad confirmandos vos
clem: Desidero enim videre vos, ut aliquid impertiar vobis gratiæ spiritualis ad confirmandos vos:
tr: επιποθω γαρ ιδειν υμας ινα τι μεταδω χαρισμα υμιν πνευματικον εις το στηριχθηναι υμας
kjv: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;

vulg: id est simul consolari in vobis per eam quae invicem est fidem vestram atque meam
clem: id est, simul consolari in vobis per eam quæ invicem est, fidem vestram atque meam.
tr: τουτο δε εστιν συμπαρακληθηναι εν υμιν δια της εν αλληλοις πιστεως υμων τε και εμου
kjv: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.

vulg: nolo autem vos ignorare fratres quia saepe proposui venire ad vos et prohibitus sum usque adhuc ut aliquem fructum habeam et in vobis sicut et in ceteris gentibus
clem: Nolo autem vos ignorare fratres: quia sæpe proposui venire ad vos (et prohibitus sum usque adhuc) ut aliquem fructum habeam et in vobis, sicut et in ceteris gentibus.
tr: ου θελω δε υμας αγνοειν αδελφοι οτι πολλακις προεθεμην ελθειν προς υμας και εκωλυθην αχρι του δευρο ινα καρπον τινα σχω και εν υμιν καθως και εν τοις λοιποις εθνεσιν
kjv: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.

vulg: Graecis ac barbaris sapientibus et insipientibus debitor sum
clem: Græcis ac barbaris, sapientibus, et insipientibus debitor sum:
tr: ελλησιν τε και βαρβαροις σοφοις τε και ανοητοις οφειλετης ειμι
kjv: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.

vulg: ita quod in me promptum est et vobis qui Romae estis evangelizare
clem: ita (quod in me) promptum est et vobis, qui Romæ estis, evangelizare.
tr: ουτως το κατ εμε προθυμον και υμιν τοις εν ρωμη ευαγγελισασθαι
kjv: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.

vulg: non enim erubesco evangelium virtus enim Dei est in salutem omni credenti Iudaeo primum et Graeco
clem: Non enim erubesco Evangelium. Virtus enim Dei est in salutem omni credenti, Judæo primum, et Græco.
tr: ου γαρ επαισχυνομαι το ευαγγελιον του χριστου δυναμις γαρ θεου εστιν εις σωτηριαν παντι τω πιστευοντι ιουδαιω τε πρωτον και ελληνι
kjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

vulg: iustitia enim Dei in eo revelatur ex fide in fidem sicut scriptum est iustus autem ex fide vivit
clem: Justitia enim Dei in eo revelatur ex fide in fidem: sicut scriptum est: Justus autem ex fide vivit.
tr: δικαιοσυνη γαρ θεου εν αυτω αποκαλυπτεται εκ πιστεως εις πιστιν καθως γεγραπται ο δε δικαιος εκ πιστεως ζησεται
kjv: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.

vulg: revelatur enim ira Dei de caelo super omnem impietatem et iniustitiam hominum eorum qui veritatem in iniustitiam detinent
clem: Revelatur enim ira Dei de cælo super omnem impietatem, et injustitiam hominum eorum, qui veritatem Dei in injustitia detinent:
tr: αποκαλυπτεται γαρ οργη θεου απ ουρανου επι πασαν ασεβειαν και αδικιαν ανθρωπων των την αληθειαν εν αδικια κατεχοντων
kjv: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;

vulg: quia quod notum est Dei manifestum est in illis Deus enim illis manifestavit
clem: quia quod notum est Dei, manifestum est in illis. Deus enim illis manifestavit.
tr: διοτι το γνωστον του θεου φανερον εστιν εν αυτοις ο γαρ θεος αυτοις εφανερωσεν
kjv: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.

vulg: invisibilia enim ipsius a creatura mundi per ea quae facta sunt intellecta conspiciuntur sempiterna quoque eius virtus et divinitas ut sint inexcusabiles
clem: Invisibilia enim ipsius, a creatura mundi, per ea quæ facta sunt, intellecta, conspiciuntur: sempiterna quoque ejus virtus, et divinitas: ita ut sint inexcusabiles.
tr: τα γαρ αορατα αυτου απο κτισεως κοσμου τοις ποιημασιν νοουμενα καθοραται η τε αιδιος αυτου δυναμις και θειοτης εις το ειναι αυτους αναπολογητους
kjv: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:

vulg: quia cum cognovissent Deum non sicut Deum glorificaverunt aut gratias egerunt sed evanuerunt in cogitationibus suis et obscuratum est insipiens cor eorum
clem: Quia cum cognovissent Deum, non sicut Deum glorificaverunt, aut gratias egerunt: sed evanuerunt in cogitationibus suis, et obscuratum est insipiens cor eorum:
tr: διοτι γνοντες τον θεον ουχ ως θεον εδοξασαν η ευχαριστησαν αλλ εματαιωθησαν εν τοις διαλογισμοις αυτων και εσκοτισθη η ασυνετος αυτων καρδια
kjv: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.

vulg: dicentes enim se esse sapientes stulti facti sunt
clem: dicentes enim se esse sapientes, stulti facti sunt.
tr: φασκοντες ειναι σοφοι εμωρανθησαν
kjv: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

vulg: et mutaverunt gloriam incorruptibilis Dei in similitudinem imaginis corruptibilis hominis et volucrum et quadrupedum et serpentium
clem: Et mutaverunt gloriam incorruptibilis Dei in similitudinem imaginis corruptibilis hominis, et volucrum, et quadrupedum, et serpentium.
tr: και ηλλαξαν την δοξαν του αφθαρτου θεου εν ομοιωματι εικονος φθαρτου ανθρωπου και πετεινων και τετραποδων και ερπετων
kjv: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.

vulg: propter quod tradidit illos Deus in desideria cordis eorum in inmunditiam ut contumeliis adficiant corpora sua in semet ipsis
clem: Propter quod tradidit illos Deus in desideria cordis eorum, in immunditiam, ut contumeliis afficiant corpora sua in semetipsis:
tr: διο και παρεδωκεν αυτους ο θεος εν ταις επιθυμιαις των καρδιων αυτων εις ακαθαρσιαν του ατιμαζεσθαι τα σωματα αυτων εν εαυτοις
kjv: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:

vulg: qui commutaverunt veritatem Dei in mendacio et coluerunt et servierunt creaturae potius quam creatori qui est benedictus in saecula amen
clem: qui commutaverunt veritatem Dei in mendacium: et coluerunt, et servierunt creaturæ potius quam Creatori, qui est benedictus in sæcula. Amen.
tr: οιτινες μετηλλαξαν την αληθειαν του θεου εν τω ψευδει και εσεβασθησαν και ελατρευσαν τη κτισει παρα τον κτισαντα ος εστιν ευλογητος εις τους αιωνας αμην
kjv: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.

vulg: propterea tradidit illos Deus in passiones ignominiae nam feminae eorum inmutaverunt naturalem usum in eum usum qui est contra naturam
clem: Propterea tradidit illos Deus in passiones ignominiæ: nam feminæ eorum immutaverunt naturalem usum in eum usum qui est contra naturam.
tr: δια τουτο παρεδωκεν αυτους ο θεος εις παθη ατιμιας αι τε γαρ θηλειαι αυτων μετηλλαξαν την φυσικην χρησιν εις την παρα φυσιν
kjv: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:

vulg: similiter autem et masculi relicto naturali usu feminae exarserunt in desideriis suis in invicem masculi in masculos turpitudinem operantes et mercedem quam oportuit erroris sui in semet ipsis recipientes
clem: Similiter autem et masculi, relicto naturali usu feminæ, exarserunt in desideriis suis in invicem, masculi in masculos turpitudinem operantes, et mercedem, quam oportuit, erroris sui in semetipsis recipientes.
tr: ομοιως τε και οι αρρενες  αρσενες  αφεντες την φυσικην χρησιν της θηλειας εξεκαυθησαν εν τη ορεξει αυτων εις αλληλους αρσενες εν αρσεσιν την ασχημοσυνην κατεργαζομενοι και την αντιμισθιαν ην εδει της πλανης αυτων εν εαυτοις απολαμβανοντες
kjv: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.

vulg: et sicut non probaverunt Deum habere in notitia tradidit eos Deus in reprobum sensum ut faciant quae non conveniunt
clem: Et sicut non probaverunt Deum habere in notitia, tradidit illos Deus in reprobum sensum, ut faciant ea quæ non conveniunt,
tr: και καθως ουκ εδοκιμασαν τον θεον εχειν εν επιγνωσει παρεδωκεν αυτους ο θεος εις αδοκιμον νουν ποιειν τα μη καθηκοντα
kjv: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;

vulg: repletos omni iniquitate malitia fornicatione avaritia nequitia plenos invidia homicidio contentione dolo malignitate susurrones
clem: repletos omni iniquitate, malitia, fornicatione, avaritia, nequitia, plenos invidia, homicidio, contentione, dolo, malignitate: susurrones,
tr: πεπληρωμενους παση αδικια πορνεια πονηρια πλεονεξια κακια μεστους φθονου φονου εριδος δολου κακοηθειας ψιθυριστας
kjv: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,

vulg: detractores Deo odibiles contumeliosos superbos elatos inventores malorum parentibus non oboedientes
clem: detractores, Deo odibiles, contumeliosos, superbos, elatos, inventores malorum, parentibus non obedientes,
tr: καταλαλους θεοστυγεις υβριστας υπερηφανους αλαζονας εφευρετας κακων γονευσιν απειθεις
kjv: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

vulg: insipientes inconpositos sine affectione absque foedere sine misericordia
clem: insipientes, incompositos, sine affectione, absque fœdere, sine misericordia.
tr: ασυνετους ασυνθετους αστοργους ασπονδους ανελεημονας
kjv: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:

vulg: qui cum iustitiam Dei cognovissent non intellexerunt quoniam qui talia agunt digni sunt morte non solum ea faciunt sed et consentiunt facientibus
clem: Qui cum justitiam Dei cognovissent, non intellexerunt quoniam qui talia agunt, digni sunt morte: et non solum qui ea faciunt, sed etiam qui consentiunt facientibus.
tr: οιτινες το δικαιωμα του θεου επιγνοντες οτι οι τα τοιαυτα πρασσοντες αξιοι θανατου εισιν ου μονον αυτα ποιουσιν αλλα και συνευδοκουσιν τοις πρασσουσιν
kjv: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.

vulg: propter quod inexcusabilis es o homo omnis qui iudicas in quo enim iudicas alterum te ipsum condemnas eadem enim agis qui iudicas
clem: Propter quod inexcusabilis es, o homo omnis qui judicas. In quo enim judicas alterum, teipsum condemnas: eadem enim agis quæ judicas.
tr: διο αναπολογητος ει ω ανθρωπε πας ο κρινων εν ω γαρ κρινεις τον ετερον σεαυτον κατακρινεις τα γαρ αυτα πρασσεις ο κρινων
kjv: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.

vulg: scimus enim quoniam iudicium Dei est secundum veritatem in eos qui talia agunt
clem: Scimus enim quoniam judicium Dei est secundum veritatem in eos qui talia agunt.
tr: οιδαμεν δε οτι το κριμα του θεου εστιν κατα αληθειαν επι τους τα τοιαυτα πρασσοντας
kjv: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.

vulg: existimas autem hoc o homo qui iudicas eos qui talia agunt et facis ea quia tu effugies iudicium Dei
clem: Existimas autem hoc, o homo, qui judicas eos qui talia agunt, et facis ea, quia tu effugies judicium Dei?
tr: λογιζη δε τουτο ω ανθρωπε ο κρινων τους τα τοιαυτα πρασσοντας και ποιων αυτα οτι συ εκφευξη το κριμα του θεου
kjv: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?

vulg: an divitias bonitatis eius et patientiae et longanimitatis contemnis ignorans quoniam benignitas Dei ad paenitentiam te adducit
clem: an divitias bonitatis ejus, et patientiæ, et longanimitatis contemnis? ignoras quoniam benignitas Dei ad pœnitentiam te adducit?
tr: η του πλουτου της χρηστοτητος αυτου και της ανοχης και της μακροθυμιας καταφρονεις αγνοων οτι το χρηστον του θεου εις μετανοιαν σε αγει
kjv: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

vulg: secundum duritiam autem tuam et inpaenitens cor thesaurizas tibi iram in die irae et revelationis iusti iudicii Dei
clem: Secundum autem duritiam tuam, et impœnitens cor, thesaurizas tibi iram in die iræ, et revelationis justi judicii Dei,
tr: κατα δε την σκληροτητα σου και αμετανοητον καρδιαν θησαυριζεις σεαυτω οργην εν ημερα οργης και αποκαλυψεως δικαιοκρισιας του θεου
kjv: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;

vulg: qui reddet unicuique secundum opera eius
clem: qui reddet unicuique secundum opera ejus:
tr: ος αποδωσει εκαστω κατα τα εργα αυτου
kjv: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:

vulg: his quidem qui secundum patientiam boni operis gloriam et honorem et incorruptionem quaerentibus vitam aeternam
clem: iis quidem qui secundum patientiam boni operis, gloriam, et honorem, et incorruptionem quærunt, vitam æternam:
tr: τοις μεν καθ υπομονην εργου αγαθου δοξαν και τιμην και αφθαρσιαν ζητουσιν ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:

vulg: his autem qui ex contentione et qui non adquiescunt veritati credunt autem iniquitati ira et indignatio
clem: iis autem qui sunt ex contentione, et qui non acquiescunt veritati, credunt autem iniquitati, ira et indignatio.
tr: τοις δε εξ εριθειας και απειθουσιν μεν τη αληθεια πειθομενοις δε τη αδικια θυμος και οργη
kjv: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,

vulg: tribulatio et angustia in omnem animam hominis operantis malum Iudaei primum et Graeci
clem: Tribulatio et angustia in omnem animam hominis operantis malum, Judæi primum, et Græci:
tr: θλιψις και στενοχωρια επι πασαν ψυχην ανθρωπου του κατεργαζομενου το κακον ιουδαιου τε πρωτον και ελληνος
kjv: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;

vulg: gloria autem et honor et pax omni operanti bonum Iudaeo primum et Graeco
clem: gloria autem, et honor, et pax omni operanti bonum, Judæo primum, et Græco:
tr: δοξα δε και τιμη και ειρηνη παντι τω εργαζομενω το αγαθον ιουδαιω τε πρωτον και ελληνι
kjv: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:

vulg: non est enim personarum acceptio apud Deum
clem: non enim est acceptio personarum apud Deum.
tr: ου γαρ εστιν προσωποληψια παρα τω θεω
kjv: For there is no respect of persons with God.

vulg: quicumque enim sine lege peccaverunt sine lege et peribunt et quicumque in lege peccaverunt per legem iudicabuntur
clem: Quicumque enim sine lege peccaverunt, sine lege peribunt: et quicumque in lege peccaverunt, per legem judicabuntur.
tr: οσοι γαρ ανομως ημαρτον ανομως και απολουνται και οσοι εν νομω ημαρτον δια νομου κριθησονται
kjv: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;

vulg: non enim auditores legis iusti sunt apud Deum sed factores legis iustificabuntur
clem: Non enim auditores legis justi sunt apud Deum, sed factores legis justificabuntur.
tr: ου γαρ οι ακροαται του νομου δικαιοι παρα τω θεω αλλ οι ποιηται του νομου δικαιωθησονται
kjv: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.

vulg: cum enim gentes quae legem non habent naturaliter quae legis sunt faciunt eiusmodi legem non habentes ipsi sibi sunt lex
clem: Cum autem gentes, quæ legem non habent, naturaliter ea, quæ legis sunt, faciunt, ejusmodi legem non habentes, ipsi sibi sunt lex:
tr: οταν γαρ εθνη τα μη νομον εχοντα φυσει τα του νομου ποιη ουτοι νομον μη εχοντες εαυτοις εισιν νομος
kjv: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:

vulg: qui ostendunt opus legis scriptum in cordibus suis testimonium reddente illis conscientia ipsorum et inter se invicem cogitationum accusantium aut etiam defendentium
clem: qui ostendunt opus legis scriptum in cordibus suis, testimonium reddente illis conscientia ipsorum, et inter se invicem cogitationibus accusantibus, aut etiam defendentibus,
tr: οιτινες ενδεικνυνται το εργον του νομου γραπτον εν ταις καρδιαις αυτων συμμαρτυρουσης αυτων της συνειδησεως και μεταξυ αλληλων των λογισμων κατηγορουντων η και απολογουμενων
kjv: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)

vulg: in die cum iudicabit Deus occulta hominum secundum evangelium meum per Iesum Christum
clem: in die, cum judicabit Deus occulta hominum, secundum Evangelium meum per Jesum Christum.
tr: εν ημερα οτε κρινει ο θεος τα κρυπτα των ανθρωπων κατα το ευαγγελιον μου δια ιησου χριστου
kjv: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.

vulg: si autem tu Iudaeus cognominaris et requiescis in lege et gloriaris in Deo
clem: Si autem tu Judæus cognominaris, et requiescis in lege, et gloriaris in Deo,
tr: ιδε συ ιουδαιος επονομαζη και επαναπαυη τω νομω και καυχασαι εν θεω
kjv: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,

vulg: et nosti voluntatem et probas utiliora instructus per legem
clem: et nosti voluntatem ejus, et probas utiliora, instructus per legem,
tr: και γινωσκεις το θελημα και δοκιμαζεις τα διαφεροντα κατηχουμενος εκ του νομου
kjv: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;

vulg: confidis te ipsum ducem esse caecorum lumen eorum qui in tenebris sunt
clem: confidis teipsum esse ducem cæcorum, lumen eorum qui in tenebris sunt,
tr: πεποιθας τε σεαυτον οδηγον ειναι τυφλων φως των εν σκοτει
kjv: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,

vulg: eruditorem insipientium magistrum infantium habentem formam scientiae et veritatis in lege
clem: eruditorem insipientium, magistrum infantium, habentem formam scientiæ, et veritatis in lege.
tr: παιδευτην αφρονων διδασκαλον νηπιων εχοντα την μορφωσιν της γνωσεως και της αληθειας εν τω νομω
kjv: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.

vulg: qui ergo alium doces te ipsum non doces qui praedicas non furandum furaris
clem: Qui ergo alium doces, teipsum non doces: qui prædicas non furandum, furaris:
tr: ο ουν διδασκων ετερον σεαυτον ου διδασκεις ο κηρυσσων μη κλεπτειν κλεπτεις
kjv: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?

vulg: qui dicis non moechandum moecharis qui abominaris idola sacrilegium facis
clem: qui dicis non mœchandum, mœcharis: qui abominaris idola, sacrilegium facis:
tr: ο λεγων μη μοιχευειν μοιχευεις ο βδελυσσομενος τα ειδωλα ιεροσυλεις
kjv: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?

vulg: qui in lege gloriaris per praevaricationem legis Deum inhonoras
clem: qui in lege gloriaris, per prævaricationem legis Deum inhonoras.
tr: ος εν νομω καυχασαι δια της παραβασεως του νομου τον θεον ατιμαζεις
kjv: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?

vulg: nomen enim Dei per vos blasphematur inter gentes sicut scriptum est
clem: (Nomen enim Dei per vos blasphematur inter gentes, sicut scriptum est.)
tr: το γαρ ονομα του θεου δι υμας βλασφημειται εν τοις εθνεσιν καθως γεγραπται
kjv: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.

vulg: circumcisio quidem prodest si legem observes si autem praevaricator legis sis circumcisio tua praeputium facta est
clem: Circumcisio quidem prodest, si legem observes: si autem prævaricator legis sis, circumcisio tua præputium facta est.
tr: περιτομη μεν γαρ ωφελει εαν νομον πρασσης εαν δε παραβατης νομου ης η περιτομη σου ακροβυστια γεγονεν
kjv: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.

vulg: si igitur praeputium iustitias legis custodiat nonne praeputium illius in circumcisionem reputabitur
clem: Si igitur præputium justitias legis custodiat, nonne præputium illius in circumcisionem reputabitur?
tr: εαν ουν η ακροβυστια τα δικαιωματα του νομου φυλασση ουχι η ακροβυστια αυτου εις περιτομην λογισθησεται
kjv: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?

vulg: et iudicabit quod ex natura est praeputium legem consummans te qui per litteram et circumcisionem praevaricator legis es
clem: et judicabit id quod ex natura est præputium, legem consummans, te, qui per litteram et circumcisionem prævaricator legis es?
tr: και κρινει η εκ φυσεως ακροβυστια τον νομον τελουσα σε τον δια γραμματος και περιτομης παραβατην νομου
kjv: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?

vulg: non enim qui in manifesto Iudaeus est neque quae in manifesto in carne circumcisio
clem: Non enim qui in manifesto, Judæus est: neque quæ in manifesto, in carne, est circumcisio:
tr: ου γαρ ο εν τω φανερω ιουδαιος εστιν ουδε η εν τω φανερω εν σαρκι περιτομη
kjv: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:

vulg: sed qui in abscondito Iudaeus et circumcisio cordis in spiritu non littera cuius laus non ex hominibus sed ex Deo est
clem: sed qui in abscondito, Judæus est: et circumcisio cordis in spiritu, non littera: cujus laus non ex hominibus, sed ex Deo est.
tr: αλλ ο εν τω κρυπτω ιουδαιος και περιτομη καρδιας εν πνευματι ου γραμματι ου ο επαινος ουκ εξ ανθρωπων αλλ εκ του θεου
kjv: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.

vulg: quid ergo amplius est Iudaeo aut quae utilitas circumcisionis
clem: Quid ergo amplius Judæo est? aut quæ utilitas circumcisionis?
tr: τι ουν το περισσον του ιουδαιου η τις η ωφελεια της περιτομης
kjv: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?

vulg: multum per omnem modum primum quidem quia credita sunt illis eloquia Dei
clem: Multum per omnem modum. Primum quidem quia credita sunt illis eloquia Dei.
tr: πολυ κατα παντα τροπον πρωτον μεν γαρ οτι επιστευθησαν τα λογια του θεου
kjv: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.

vulg: quid enim si quidam illorum non crediderunt numquid incredulitas illorum fidem Dei evacuabit absit
clem: Quid enim si quidam illorum non crediderunt? numquid incredulitas illorum fidem Dei evacuabit? Absit.
tr: τι γαρ ει ηπιστησαν τινες μη η απιστια αυτων την πιστιν του θεου καταργησει
kjv: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?

vulg: est autem Deus verax omnis autem homo mendax sicut scriptum est ut iustificeris in sermonibus tuis et vincas cum iudicaris
clem: Est autem Deus verax: omnis autem homo mendax, sicut scriptum est: [Ut justificeris in sermonibus tuis: et vincas cum judicaris.]
tr: μη γενοιτο γινεσθω δε ο θεος αληθης πας δε ανθρωπος ψευστης καθως γεγραπται οπως αν δικαιωθης εν τοις λογοις σου και νικησης εν τω κρινεσθαι σε
kjv: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.

vulg: si autem iniquitas nostra iustitiam Dei commendat quid dicemus numquid iniquus Deus qui infert iram secundum hominem dico
clem: Si autem iniquitas nostra justitiam Dei commendat, quid dicemus? Numquid iniquus est Deus, qui infert iram?
tr: ει δε η αδικια ημων θεου δικαιοσυνην συνιστησιν τι ερουμεν μη αδικος ο θεος ο επιφερων την οργην κατα ανθρωπον λεγω
kjv: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)

vulg: absit alioquin quomodo iudicabit Deus mundum
clem: secundum hominem dico. Absit. Alioquin quomodo judicabit Deus hunc mundum?
tr: μη γενοιτο επει πως κρινει ο θεος τον κοσμον
kjv: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?

vulg: si enim veritas Dei in meo mendacio abundavit in gloriam ipsius quid adhuc et ego tamquam peccator iudicor
clem: Si enim veritas Dei in meo mendacio abundavit in gloriam ipsius: quid adhuc et ego tamquam peccator judicor?
tr: ει γαρ η αληθεια του θεου εν τω εμω ψευσματι επερισσευσεν εις την δοξαν αυτου τι ετι καγω ως αμαρτωλος κρινομαι
kjv: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?

vulg: et non sicut blasphemamur et sicut aiunt nos quidam dicere faciamus mala ut veniant bona quorum damnatio iusta est
clem: et non (sicut blasphemamur, et sicut aiunt quidam nos dicere) faciamus mala ut veniant bona: quorum damnatio justa est.
tr: και μη καθως βλασφημουμεθα και καθως φασιν τινες ημας λεγειν οτι ποιησωμεν τα κακα ινα ελθη τα αγαθα ων το κριμα ενδικον εστιν
kjv: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.

vulg: quid igitur praecellimus eos nequaquam causati enim sumus Iudaeos et Graecos omnes sub peccato esse
clem: Quid ergo? præcellimus eos? Nequaquam. Causati enim sumus Judæos et Græcos omnes sub peccato esse,
tr: τι ουν προεχομεθα ου παντως προητιασαμεθα γαρ ιουδαιους τε και ελληνας παντας υφ αμαρτιαν ειναι
kjv: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;

vulg: sicut scriptum est quia non est iustus quisquam
clem: sicut scriptum est: [Quia non est justus quisquam:
tr: καθως γεγραπται οτι ουκ εστιν δικαιος ουδε εις
kjv: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:

vulg: non est intellegens non est requirens Deum
clem: non est intelligens, non est requirens Deum.
tr: ουκ εστιν ο συνιων ουκ εστιν ο εκζητων τον θεον
kjv: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.

vulg: omnes declinaverunt simul inutiles facti sunt non est qui faciat bonum non est usque ad unum
clem: Omnes declinaverunt, simul inutiles facti sunt: non est qui faciat bonum, non est usque ad unum.
tr: παντες εξεκλιναν αμα ηχρειωθησαν ουκ εστιν ποιων χρηστοτητα ουκ εστιν εως ενος
kjv: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

vulg: sepulchrum patens est guttur eorum linguis suis dolose agebant venenum aspidum sub labiis eorum
clem: Sepulchrum patens est guttur eorum, linguis suis dolose agebant: venenum aspidum sub labiis eorum:
tr: ταφος ανεωγμενος ο λαρυγξ αυτων ταις γλωσσαις αυτων εδολιουσαν ιος ασπιδων υπο τα χειλη αυτων
kjv: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:

vulg: quorum os maledictione et amaritudine plenum est
clem: quorum os maledictione, et amaritudine plenum est:
tr: ων το στομα αρας και πικριας γεμει
kjv: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:

vulg: veloces pedes eorum ad effundendum sanguinem
clem: veloces pedes eorum ad effundendum sanguinem:
tr: οξεις οι ποδες αυτων εκχεαι αιμα
kjv: Their feet are swift to shed blood:

vulg: contritio et infelicitas in viis eorum
clem: contritio et infelicitas in viis eorum:
tr: συντριμμα και ταλαιπωρια εν ταις οδοις αυτων
kjv: Destruction and misery are in their ways:

vulg: et viam pacis non cognoverunt
clem: et viam pacis non cognoverunt:
tr: και οδον ειρηνης ουκ εγνωσαν
kjv: And the way of peace have they not known:

vulg: non est timor Dei ante oculos eorum
clem: non est timor Dei ante oculos eorum.]
tr: ουκ εστιν φοβος θεου απεναντι των οφθαλμων αυτων
kjv: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

vulg: scimus autem quoniam quaecumque lex loquitur his qui in lege sunt loquitur ut omne os obstruatur et subditus fiat omnis mundus Deo
clem: Scimus autem quoniam quæcumque lex loquitur, iis, qui in lege sunt, loquitur: ut omne os obstruatur, et subditus fiat omnis mundus Deo:
tr: οιδαμεν δε οτι οσα ο νομος λεγει τοις εν τω νομω λαλει ινα παν στομα φραγη και υποδικος γενηται πας ο κοσμος τω θεω
kjv: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.

vulg: quia ex operibus legis non iustificabitur omnis caro coram illo per legem enim cognitio peccati
clem: quia ex operibus legis non justificabitur omnis caro coram illo. Per legem enim cognitio peccati.
tr: διοτι εξ εργων νομου ου δικαιωθησεται πασα σαρξ ενωπιον αυτου δια γαρ νομου επιγνωσις αμαρτιας
kjv: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.

vulg: nunc autem sine lege iustitia Dei manifestata est testificata a lege et prophetis
clem: Nunc autem sine lege justitia Dei manifestata est: testificata a lege et prophetis.
tr: νυνι δε χωρις νομου δικαιοσυνη θεου πεφανερωται μαρτυρουμενη υπο του νομου και των προφητων
kjv: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;

vulg: iustitia autem Dei per fidem Iesu Christi super omnes qui credunt non enim est distinctio
clem: Justitia autem Dei per fidem Jesu Christi in omnes et super omnes qui credunt in eum: non enim est distinctio:
tr: δικαιοσυνη δε θεου δια πιστεως ιησου χριστου εις παντας και επι παντας τους πιστευοντας ου γαρ εστιν διαστολη
kjv: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:

vulg: omnes enim peccaverunt et egent gloriam Dei
clem: omnes enim peccaverunt, et egent gloria Dei.
tr: παντες γαρ ημαρτον και υστερουνται της δοξης του θεου
kjv: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;

vulg: iustificati gratis per gratiam ipsius per redemptionem quae est in Christo Iesu
clem: Justificati gratis per gratiam ipsius, per redemptionem quæ est in Christo Jesu,
tr: δικαιουμενοι δωρεαν τη αυτου χαριτι δια της απολυτρωσεως της εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:

vulg: quem proposuit Deus propitiationem per fidem in sanguine ipsius ad ostensionem iustitiae suae propter remissionem praecedentium delictorum
clem: quem proposuit Deus propitiationem per fidem in sanguine ipsius, ad ostensionem justitiæ suæ propter remissionem præcedentium delictorum
tr: ον προεθετο ο θεος ιλαστηριον δια της πιστεως εν τω αυτου αιματι εις ενδειξιν της δικαιοσυνης αυτου δια την παρεσιν των προγεγονοτων αμαρτηματων
kjv: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;

vulg: in sustentatione Dei ad ostensionem iustitiae eius in hoc tempore ut sit ipse iustus et iustificans eum qui ex fide est Iesu
clem: in sustentatione Dei, ad ostensionem justitiæ ejus in hoc tempore: ut sit ipse justus, et justificans eum, qui est ex fide Jesu Christi.
tr: εν τη ανοχη του θεου προς ενδειξιν της δικαιοσυνης αυτου εν τω νυν καιρω εις το ειναι αυτον δικαιον και δικαιουντα τον εκ πιστεως ιησου
kjv: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.

vulg: ubi est ergo gloriatio exclusa est per quam legem factorum non sed per legem fidei
clem: Ubi est ergo gloriatio tua? Exclusa est. Per quam legem? Factorum? Non: sed per legem fidei.
tr: που ουν η καυχησις εξεκλεισθη δια ποιου νομου των εργων ουχι αλλα δια νομου πιστεως
kjv: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.

vulg: arbitramur enim iustificari hominem per fidem sine operibus legis
clem: Arbitramur enim justificari hominem per fidem sine operibus legis.
tr: λογιζομεθα ουν πιστει δικαιουσθαι ανθρωπον χωρις εργων νομου
kjv: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.

vulg: an Iudaeorum Deus tantum nonne et gentium immo et gentium
clem: An Judæorum Deus tantum? nonne et gentium? Immo et gentium:
tr: η ιουδαιων ο θεος μονον ουχι δε και εθνων ναι και εθνων
kjv: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:

vulg: quoniam quidem unus Deus qui iustificabit circumcisionem ex fide et praeputium per fidem
clem: quoniam quidem unus est Deus, qui justificat circumcisionem ex fide, et præputium per fidem.
tr: επειπερ εις ο θεος ος δικαιωσει περιτομην εκ πιστεως και ακροβυστιαν δια της πιστεως
kjv: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.

vulg: legem ergo destruimus per fidem absit sed legem statuimus
clem: Legem ergo destruimus per fidem? Absit: sed legem statuimus.
tr: νομον ουν καταργουμεν δια της πιστεως μη γενοιτο αλλα νομον ιστωμεν
kjv: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.

vulg: quid ergo dicemus invenisse Abraham patrem nostrum secundum carnem
clem: Quid ergo dicemus invenisse Abraham patrem nostrum secundum carnem?
tr: τι ουν ερουμεν αβρααμ τον πατερα ημων ευρηκεναι κατα σαρκα
kjv: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?

vulg: si enim Abraham ex operibus iustificatus est habet gloriam sed non apud Deum
clem: Si enim Abraham ex operibus justificatus est, habet gloriam, sed non apud Deum.
tr: ει γαρ αβρααμ εξ εργων εδικαιωθη εχει καυχημα αλλ ου προς τον θεον
kjv: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.

vulg: quid enim scriptura dicit credidit Abraham Deo et reputatum est illi ad iustitiam
clem: Quid enim dicit Scriptura? Credidit Abraham Deo, et reputatam est illi ad justitiam.
tr: τι γαρ η γραφη λεγει επιστευσεν δε αβρααμ τω θεω και ελογισθη αυτω εις δικαιοσυνην
kjv: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.

vulg: ei autem qui operatur merces non inputatur secundum gratiam sed secundum debitum
clem: Ei autem qui operatur, merces non imputatur secundum gratiam, sed secundum debitum.
tr: τω δε εργαζομενω ο μισθος ου λογιζεται κατα χαριν αλλα κατα το οφειλημα
kjv: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.

vulg: ei vero qui non operatur credenti autem in eum qui iustificat impium reputatur fides eius ad iustitiam
clem: Ei vero qui non operatur, credenti autem in eum, qui justificat impium, reputatur fides ejus ad justitiam secundum propositum gratiæ Dei.
tr: τω δε μη εργαζομενω πιστευοντι δε επι τον δικαιουντα τον ασεβη λογιζεται η πιστις αυτου εις δικαιοσυνην
kjv: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.

vulg: sicut et David dicit beatitudinem hominis cui Deus accepto fert iustitiam sine operibus
clem: Sicut et David dicit beatitudinem hominis, cui Deus accepto fert justitiam sine operibus:
tr: καθαπερ και δαβιδ λεγει τον μακαρισμον του ανθρωπου ω ο θεος λογιζεται δικαιοσυνην χωρις εργων
kjv: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,

vulg: beati quorum remissae sunt iniquitates et quorum tecta sunt peccata
clem: [Beati, quorum remissæ sunt iniquitates, et quorum tecta sunt peccata.
tr: μακαριοι ων αφεθησαν αι ανομιαι και ων επεκαλυφθησαν αι αμαρτιαι
kjv: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.

vulg: beatus vir cui non inputabit Dominus peccatum
clem: Beatus vir, cui non imputavit Dominus peccatum.]
tr: μακαριος ανηρ ω ου μη λογισηται κυριος αμαρτιαν
kjv: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.

vulg: beatitudo ergo haec in circumcisione an etiam in praeputio dicimus enim quia reputata est Abrahae fides ad iustitiam
clem: Beatitudo ergo hæc in circumcisione tantum manet, an etiam in præputio? Dicimus enim quia reputata est Abrahæ fides ad justitiam.
tr: ο μακαρισμος ουν ουτος επι την περιτομην η και επι την ακροβυστιαν λεγομεν γαρ οτι ελογισθη τω αβρααμ η πιστις εις δικαιοσυνην
kjv: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.

vulg: quomodo ergo reputata est in circumcisione an in praeputio non in circumcisione sed in praeputio
clem: Quomodo ergo reputata est? in circumcisione, an in præputio? Non in circumcisione, sed in præputio.
tr: πως ουν ελογισθη εν περιτομη οντι η εν ακροβυστια ουκ εν περιτομη αλλ εν ακροβυστια
kjv: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

vulg: et signum accepit circumcisionis signaculum iustitiae fidei quae est in praeputio ut sit pater omnium credentium per praeputium ut reputetur et illis ad iustitiam
clem: Et signum accepit circumcisionis, signaculum justitiæ fidei, quæ est in præputio: ut sit pater omnium credentium per præputium, ut reputetur et illis ad justitiam:
tr: και σημειον ελαβεν περιτομης σφραγιδα της δικαιοσυνης της πιστεως της εν τη ακροβυστια εις το ειναι αυτον πατερα παντων των πιστευοντων δι ακροβυστιας εις το λογισθηναι και αυτοις την δικαιοσυνην
kjv: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:

vulg: et sit pater circumcisionis non his tantum qui sunt ex circumcisione sed et his qui sectantur vestigia quae est in praeputio fidei patris nostri Abrahae
clem: et sit pater circumcisionis non iis tantum, qui sunt ex circumcisione, sed et iis qui sectantur vestigia fidei, quæ est in præputio patris nostri Abrahæ.
tr: και πατερα περιτομης τοις ουκ εκ περιτομης μονον αλλα και τοις στοιχουσιν τοις ιχνεσιν της εν τη ακροβυστια πιστεως του πατρος ημων αβρααμ
kjv: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.

vulg: non enim per legem promissio Abrahae aut semini eius ut heres esset mundi sed per iustitiam fidei
clem: Non enim per legem promissio Abrahæ, aut semini ejus ut hæres esset mundi: sed per justitiam fidei.
tr: ου γαρ δια νομου η επαγγελια τω αβρααμ η τω σπερματι αυτου το κληρονομον αυτον ειναι του κοσμου αλλα δια δικαιοσυνης πιστεως
kjv: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

vulg: si enim qui ex lege heredes sunt exinanita est fides abolita est promissio
clem: Si enim qui ex lege, hæredes sunt: exinanita est fides, abolita est promissio.
tr: ει γαρ οι εκ νομου κληρονομοι κεκενωται η πιστις και κατηργηται η επαγγελια
kjv: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:

vulg: lex enim iram operatur ubi enim non est lex nec praevaricatio
clem: Lex enim iram operatur. Ubi enim non est lex, nec prævaricatio.
tr: ο γαρ νομος οργην κατεργαζεται ου γαρ ουκ εστιν νομος ουδε παραβασις
kjv: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.

vulg: ideo ex fide ut secundum gratiam ut firma sit promissio omni semini non ei qui ex lege est solum sed et ei qui ex fide est Abrahae qui est pater omnium nostrum
clem: Ideo ex fide, ut secundum gratiam firma sit promissio omni semini, non ei qui ex lege est solum, sed et ei qui ex fide est Abrahæ, qui pater est omnium nostrum
tr: δια τουτο εκ πιστεως ινα κατα χαριν εις το ειναι βεβαιαν την επαγγελιαν παντι τω σπερματι ου τω εκ του νομου μονον αλλα και τω εκ πιστεως αβρααμ ος εστιν πατηρ παντων ημων
kjv: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,

vulg: sicut scriptum est quia patrem multarum gentium posui te ante Deum cui credidit qui vivificat mortuos et vocat quae non sunt tamquam ea quae sunt
clem: (sicut scriptum est: Quia patrem multarum gentium posui te) ante Deum, cui credidit, qui vivificat mortuos, et vocat ea quæ non sunt, tamquam ea quæ sunt:
tr: καθως γεγραπται οτι πατερα πολλων εθνων τεθεικα σε κατεναντι ου επιστευσεν θεου του ζωοποιουντος τους νεκρους και καλουντος τα μη οντα ως οντα
kjv: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.

vulg: qui contra spem in spem credidit ut fieret pater multarum gentium secundum quod dictum est sic erit semen tuum
clem: qui contra spem in spem credidit, ut fieret pater multarum gentium secundum quod dictum est ei: Sic erit semen tuum.
tr: ος παρ ελπιδα επ ελπιδι επιστευσεν εις το γενεσθαι αυτον πατερα πολλων εθνων κατα το ειρημενον ουτως εσται το σπερμα σου
kjv: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.

vulg: et non infirmatus fide consideravit corpus suum emortuum cum fere centum annorum esset et emortuam vulvam Sarrae
clem: Et non infirmatus est fide, nec consideravit corpus suum emortuum, cum jam fere centum esset annorum, et emortuam vulvam Saræ.
tr: και μη ασθενησας τη πιστει ου κατενοησεν το εαυτου σωμα ηδη νενεκρωμενον εκατονταετης που υπαρχων και την νεκρωσιν της μητρας σαρρας
kjv: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sarah's womb:

vulg: in repromissione etiam Dei non haesitavit diffidentia sed confortatus est fide dans gloriam Deo
clem: In repromissione etiam Dei non hæsitavit diffidentia, sed confortatus est fide, dans gloriam Deo:
tr: εις δε την επαγγελιαν του θεου ου διεκριθη τη απιστια αλλ ενεδυναμωθη τη πιστει δους δοξαν τω θεω
kjv: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;

vulg: plenissime sciens quia quaecumque promisit potens est et facere
clem: plenissime sciens, quia quæcumque promisit, potens est et facere.
tr: και πληροφορηθεις οτι ο επηγγελται δυνατος εστιν και ποιησαι
kjv: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.

vulg: ideo et reputatum est illi ad iustitiam
clem: Ideo et reputatum est illi ad justitiam.
tr: διο και ελογισθη αυτω εις δικαιοσυνην
kjv: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.

vulg: non est autem scriptum tantum propter ipsum quia reputatum est illi
clem: Non est autem scriptum tantum propter ipsum quia reputatum est illi ad justitiam:
tr: ουκ εγραφη δε δι αυτον μονον οτι ελογισθη αυτω
kjv: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;

vulg: sed et propter nos quibus reputabitur credentibus in eum qui suscitavit Iesum Dominum nostrum a mortuis
clem: sed et propter nos, quibus reputabitur credentibus in eum, qui suscitavit Jesum Christum Dominum nostrum a mortuis,
tr: αλλα και δι ημας οις μελλει λογιζεσθαι τοις πιστευουσιν επι τον εγειραντα ιησουν τον κυριον ημων εκ νεκρων
kjv: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;

vulg: qui traditus est propter delicta nostra et resurrexit propter iustificationem nostram
clem: qui traditus est propter delicta nostra, et resurrexit propter justificationem nostram.
tr: ος παρεδοθη δια τα παραπτωματα ημων και ηγερθη δια την δικαιωσιν ημων
kjv: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

vulg: iustificati igitur ex fide pacem habeamus ad Deum per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum
clem: Justificati ergo ex fide, pacem habeamus ad Deum per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum:
tr: δικαιωθεντες ουν εκ πιστεως ειρηνην εχομεν προς τον θεον δια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:

vulg: per quem et accessum habemus fide in gratiam istam in qua stamus et gloriamur in spe gloriae filiorum Dei
clem: per quem et habemus accessum per fidem in gratiam istam, in qua stamus, et gloriamur in spe gloriæ filiorum Dei.
tr: δι ου και την προσαγωγην εσχηκαμεν τη πιστει εις την χαριν ταυτην εν η εστηκαμεν και καυχωμεθα επ ελπιδι της δοξης του θεου
kjv: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

vulg: non solum autem sed et gloriamur in tribulationibus scientes quod tribulatio patientiam operatur
clem: Non solum autem, sed et gloriamur in tribulationibus: scientes quod tribulatio patientiam operatur:
tr: ου μονον δε αλλα και καυχωμεθα εν ταις θλιψεσιν ειδοτες οτι η θλιψις υπομονην κατεργαζεται
kjv: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;

vulg: patientia autem probationem probatio vero spem
clem: patientia autem probationem, probatio vero spem,
tr: η δε υπομονη δοκιμην η δε δοκιμη ελπιδα
kjv: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:

vulg: spes autem non confundit quia caritas Dei diffusa est in cordibus nostris per Spiritum Sanctum qui datus est nobis
clem: spes autem non confundit: quia caritas Dei diffusa est in cordibus nostris per Spiritum Sanctum, qui datus est nobis.
tr: η δε ελπις ου καταισχυνει οτι η αγαπη του θεου εκκεχυται εν ταις καρδιαις ημων δια πνευματος αγιου του δοθεντος ημιν
kjv: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.

vulg: ut quid enim Christus cum adhuc infirmi essemus secundum tempus pro impiis mortuus est
clem: Ut quid enim Christus, cum adhuc infirmi essemus, secundum tempus, pro impiis mortuus est?
tr: ετι γαρ χριστος οντων ημων ασθενων κατα καιρον υπερ ασεβων απεθανεν
kjv: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.

vulg: vix enim pro iusto quis moritur nam pro bono forsitan quis et audeat mori
clem: vix enim pro justo quis moritur: nam pro bono forsitan quis audeat mori.
tr: μολις γαρ υπερ δικαιου τις αποθανειται υπερ γαρ του αγαθου ταχα τις και τολμα αποθανειν
kjv: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.

vulg: commendat autem suam caritatem Deus in nos quoniam cum adhuc peccatores essemus
clem: Commendat autem caritatem suam Deus in nobis: quoniam cum adhuc peccatores essemus, secundum tempus,
tr: συνιστησιν δε την εαυτου αγαπην εις ημας ο θεος οτι ετι αμαρτωλων οντων ημων χριστος υπερ ημων απεθανεν
kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

vulg: Christus pro nobis mortuus est multo igitur magis iustificati nunc in sanguine ipsius salvi erimus ab ira per ipsum
clem: Christus pro nobis mortuus est: multo igitur magis nunc justificati in sanguine ipsius, salvi erimus ab ira per ipsum.
tr: πολλω ουν μαλλον δικαιωθεντες νυν εν τω αιματι αυτου σωθησομεθα δι αυτου απο της οργης
kjv: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.

vulg: si enim cum inimici essemus reconciliati sumus Deo per mortem Filii eius multo magis reconciliati salvi erimus in vita ipsius
clem: Si enim cum inimici essemus, reconciliati sumus Deo per mortem filii ejus: multo magis reconciliati, salvi erimus in vita ipsius.
tr: ει γαρ εχθροι οντες κατηλλαγημεν τω θεω δια του θανατου του υιου αυτου πολλω μαλλον καταλλαγεντες σωθησομεθα εν τη ζωη αυτου
kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.

vulg: non solum autem sed et gloriamur in Deo per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum per quem nunc reconciliationem accepimus
clem: Non solum autem: sed et gloriamur in Deo per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, per quem nunc reconciliationem accepimus.
tr: ου μονον δε αλλα και καυχωμενοι εν τω θεω δια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου δι ου νυν την καταλλαγην ελαβομεν
kjv: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.

vulg: propterea sicut per unum hominem in hunc mundum peccatum intravit et per peccatum mors et ita in omnes homines mors pertransiit in quo omnes peccaverunt
clem: Propterea sicut per unum hominem peccatum in hunc mundum intravit, et per peccatum mors, et ita in omnes homines mors pertransiit, in quo omnes peccaverunt.
tr: δια τουτο ωσπερ δι ενος ανθρωπου η αμαρτια εις τον κοσμον εισηλθεν και δια της αμαρτιας ο θανατος και ουτως εις παντας ανθρωπους ο θανατος διηλθεν εφ ω παντες ημαρτον
kjv: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:

vulg: usque ad legem enim peccatum erat in mundo peccatum autem non inputatur cum lex non est
clem: Usque ad legem enim peccatum erat in mundo: peccatum autem non imputabatur, cum lex non esset.
tr: αχρι γαρ νομου αμαρτια ην εν κοσμω αμαρτια δε ουκ ελλογειται μη οντος νομου
kjv: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.

vulg: sed regnavit mors ab Adam usque ad Mosen etiam in eos qui non peccaverunt in similitudinem praevaricationis Adae qui est forma futuri
clem: Sed regnavit mors ab Adam usque ad Moysen etiam in eos qui non peccaverunt in similitudinem prævaricationis Adæ, qui est forma futuri.
tr: αλλ εβασιλευσεν ο θανατος απο αδαμ μεχρι μωσεως και επι τους μη αμαρτησαντας επι τω ομοιωματι της παραβασεως αδαμ ος εστιν τυπος του μελλοντος
kjv: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.

vulg: sed non sicut delictum ita et donum si enim unius delicto multi mortui sunt multo magis gratia Dei et donum in gratiam unius hominis Iesu Christi in plures abundavit
clem: Sed non sicut delictum, ita et donum: si enim unius delicto multi mortui sunt: multo magis gratia Dei et donum in gratia unius hominis Jesu Christi in plures abundavit.
tr: αλλ ουχ ως το παραπτωμα ουτως και το χαρισμα ει γαρ τω του ενος παραπτωματι οι πολλοι απεθανον πολλω μαλλον η χαρις του θεου και η δωρεα εν χαριτι τη του ενος ανθρωπου ιησου χριστου εις τους πολλους επερισσευσεν
kjv: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.

vulg: et non sicut per unum peccantem ita et donum nam iudicium ex uno in condemnationem gratia autem ex multis delictis in iustificationem
clem: Et non sicut per unum peccatum, ita et donum. Nam judicium quidem ex uno in condemnationem: gratia autem ex multis delictis in justificationem.
tr: και ουχ ως δι ενος αμαρτησαντος το δωρημα το μεν γαρ κριμα εξ ενος εις κατακριμα το δε χαρισμα εκ πολλων παραπτωματων εις δικαιωμα
kjv: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.

vulg: si enim in unius delicto mors regnavit per unum multo magis abundantiam gratiae et donationis et iustitiae accipientes in vita regnabunt per unum Iesum Christum
clem: Si enim unius delicto mors regnavit per unum: multo magis abundantiam gratiæ, et donationis, et justitiæ accipientes, in vita regnabunt per unum Jesum Christum.
tr: ει γαρ τω του ενος παραπτωματι ο θανατος εβασιλευσεν δια του ενος πολλω μαλλον οι την περισσειαν της χαριτος και της δωρεας της δικαιοσυνης λαμβανοντες εν ζωη βασιλευσουσιν δια του ενος ιησου χριστου
kjv: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)

vulg: igitur sicut per unius delictum in omnes homines in condemnationem sic et per unius iustitiam in omnes homines in iustificationem vitae
clem: Igitur sicut per unius delictum in omnes homines in condemnationem: sic et per unius justitiam in omnes homines in justificationem vitæ.
tr: αρα ουν ως δι ενος παραπτωματος εις παντας ανθρωπους εις κατακριμα ουτως και δι ενος δικαιωματος εις παντας ανθρωπους εις δικαιωσιν ζωης
kjv: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.

vulg: sicut enim per inoboedientiam unius hominis peccatores constituti sunt multi ita et per unius oboeditionem iusti constituentur multi
clem: Sicut enim per inobedientiam unius hominis, peccatores constituti sunt multi: ita et per unius obeditionem, justi constituentur multi.
tr: ωσπερ γαρ δια της παρακοης του ενος ανθρωπου αμαρτωλοι κατεσταθησαν οι πολλοι ουτως και δια της υπακοης του ενος δικαιοι κατασταθησονται οι πολλοι
kjv: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.

vulg: lex autem subintravit ut abundaret delictum ubi autem abundavit delictum superabundavit gratia
clem: Lex autem subintravit ut abundaret delictum. Ubi autem abundavit delictum, superabundavit gratia:
tr: νομος δε παρεισηλθεν ινα πλεοναση το παραπτωμα ου δε επλεονασεν η αμαρτια υπερεπερισσευσεν η χαρις
kjv: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:

vulg: ut sicut regnavit peccatum in morte ita et gratia regnet per iustitiam in vitam aeternam per Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum
clem: ut sicut regnavit peccatum in mortem: ita et gratia regnet per justitiam in vitam æternam, per Jesum Christum Dominum nostrum.
tr: ινα ωσπερ εβασιλευσεν η αμαρτια εν τω θανατω ουτως και η χαρις βασιλευση δια δικαιοσυνης εις ζωην αιωνιον δια ιησου χριστου του κυριου ημων
kjv: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.

vulg: quid ergo dicemus permanebimus in peccato ut gratia abundet
clem: Quid ergo dicemus? permanebimus in peccato ut gratia abundet?
tr: τι ουν ερουμεν επιμενουμεν τη αμαρτια ινα η χαρις πλεοναση
kjv: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

vulg: absit qui enim mortui sumus peccato quomodo adhuc vivemus in illo
clem: Absit. Qui enim mortui sumus peccato, quomodo adhuc vivemus in illo?
tr: μη γενοιτο οιτινες απεθανομεν τη αμαρτια πως ετι ζησομεν εν αυτη
kjv: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?

vulg: an ignoratis quia quicumque baptizati sumus in Christo Iesu in morte ipsius baptizati sumus
clem: an ignoratis quia quicumque baptizati sumus in Christo Jesu, in morte ipsius baptizati sumus?
tr: η αγνοειτε οτι οσοι εβαπτισθημεν εις χριστον ιησουν εις τον θανατον αυτου εβαπτισθημεν
kjv: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?

vulg: consepulti enim sumus cum illo per baptismum in mortem ut quomodo surrexit Christus a mortuis per gloriam Patris ita et nos in novitate vitae ambulemus
clem: Consepulti enim sumus cum illo per baptismum in mortem: ut quomodo Christus surrexit a mortuis per gloriam Patris, ita et nos in novitate vitæ ambulemus.
tr: συνεταφημεν ουν αυτω δια του βαπτισματος εις τον θανατον ινα ωσπερ ηγερθη χριστος εκ νεκρων δια της δοξης του πατρος ουτως και ημεις εν καινοτητι ζωης περιπατησωμεν
kjv: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.

vulg: si enim conplantati facti sumus similitudini mortis eius simul et resurrectionis erimus
clem: Si enim complantati facti sumus similitudini mortis ejus: simul et resurrectionis erimus.
tr: ει γαρ συμφυτοι γεγοναμεν τω ομοιωματι του θανατου αυτου αλλα και της αναστασεως εσομεθα
kjv: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:

vulg: hoc scientes quia vetus homo noster simul crucifixus est ut destruatur corpus peccati ut ultra non serviamus peccato
clem: Hoc scientes, quia vetus homo noster simul crucifixus est, ut destruatur corpus peccati, et ultra non serviamus peccato.
tr: τουτο γινωσκοντες οτι ο παλαιος ημων ανθρωπος συνεσταυρωθη ινα καταργηθη το σωμα της αμαρτιας του μηκετι δουλευειν ημας τη αμαρτια
kjv: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.

vulg: qui enim mortuus est iustificatus est a peccato
clem: Qui enim mortuus est, justificatus est a peccato.
tr: ο γαρ αποθανων δεδικαιωται απο της αμαρτιας
kjv: For he that is dead is freed from sin.

vulg: si autem mortui sumus cum Christo credimus quia simul etiam vivemus cum Christo
clem: Si autem mortui sumus cum Christo, credimus quia simul etiam vivemus cum Christo,
tr: ει δε απεθανομεν συν χριστω πιστευομεν οτι και συζησομεν αυτω
kjv: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:

vulg: scientes quod Christus surgens ex mortuis iam non moritur mors illi ultra non dominabitur
clem: scientes quod Christus resurgens ex mortuis jam non moritur: mors illi ultra non dominabitur.
tr: ειδοτες οτι χριστος εγερθεις εκ νεκρων ουκετι αποθνησκει θανατος αυτου ουκετι κυριευει
kjv: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.

vulg: quod enim mortuus est peccato mortuus est semel quod autem vivit vivit Deo
clem: Quod enim mortuus est peccato, mortuus est semel: quod autem vivit, vivit Deo.
tr: ο γαρ απεθανεν τη αμαρτια απεθανεν εφαπαξ ο δε ζη ζη τω θεω
kjv: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.

vulg: ita et vos existimate vos mortuos quidem esse peccato viventes autem Deo in Christo Iesu
clem: Ita et vos existimate vos mortuos quidem esse peccato, viventes autem Deo, in Christo Jesu Domino nostro.
tr: ουτως και υμεις λογιζεσθε εαυτους νεκρους μεν ειναι τη αμαρτια ζωντας δε τω θεω εν χριστω ιησου τω κυριω ημων
kjv: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.

vulg: non ergo regnet peccatum in vestro mortali corpore ut oboediatis concupiscentiis eius
clem: Non ergo regnet peccatum in vestro mortali corpore ut obediatis concupiscentiis ejus.
tr: μη ουν βασιλευετω η αμαρτια εν τω θνητω υμων σωματι εις το υπακουειν αυτη εν ταις επιθυμιαις αυτου
kjv: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.

vulg: sed neque exhibeatis membra vestra arma iniquitatis peccato sed exhibete vos Deo tamquam ex mortuis viventes et membra vestra arma iustitiae Deo
clem: Sed neque exhibeatis membra vestra arma iniquitatis peccato: sed exhibete vos Deo, tamquam ex mortuis viventes: et membra vestra arma justitiæ Deo.
tr: μηδε παριστανετε τα μελη υμων οπλα αδικιας τη αμαρτια αλλα παραστησατε εαυτους τω θεω ως εκ νεκρων ζωντας και τα μελη υμων οπλα δικαιοσυνης τω θεω
kjv: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.

vulg: peccatum enim vobis non dominabitur non enim sub lege estis sed sub gratia
clem: Peccatum enim vobis non dominabitur: non enim sub lege estis, sed sub gratia.
tr: αμαρτια γαρ υμων ου κυριευσει ου γαρ εστε υπο νομον αλλ υπο χαριν
kjv: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.

vulg: quid ergo peccavimus quoniam non sumus sub lege sed sub gratia absit
clem: Quid ergo? peccabimus, quoniam non sumus sub lege, sed sub gratia? Absit.
tr: τι ουν αμαρτησομεν οτι ουκ εσμεν υπο νομον αλλ υπο χαριν μη γενοιτο
kjv: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.

vulg: nescitis quoniam cui exhibetis vos servos ad oboediendum servi estis eius cui oboeditis sive peccati sive oboeditionis ad iustitiam
clem: Nescitis quoniam cui exhibetis vos servos ad obediendum, servi estis ejus, cui obeditis, sive peccati ad mortem, sive obeditionis ad justitiam?
tr: ουκ οιδατε οτι ω παριστανετε εαυτους δουλους εις υπακοην δουλοι εστε ω υπακουετε ητοι αμαρτιας εις θανατον η υπακοης εις δικαιοσυνην
kjv: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?

vulg: gratias autem Deo quod fuistis servi peccati oboedistis autem ex corde in eam formam doctrinae in qua traditi estis
clem: Gratias autem Deo quod fuistis servi peccati, obedistis autem ex corde in eam formam doctrinæ, in quam traditi estis.
tr: χαρις δε τω θεω οτι ητε δουλοι της αμαρτιας υπηκουσατε δε εκ καρδιας εις ον παρεδοθητε τυπον διδαχης
kjv: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.

vulg: liberati autem a peccato servi facti estis iustitiae
clem: Liberati autem a peccato, servi facti estis justitiæ.
tr: ελευθερωθεντες δε απο της αμαρτιας εδουλωθητε τη δικαιοσυνη
kjv: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.

vulg: humanum dico propter infirmitatem carnis vestrae sicut enim exhibuistis membra vestra servire inmunditiae et iniquitati ad iniquitatem ita nunc exhibete membra vestra servire iustitiae in sanctificationem
clem: Humanum dico, propter infirmitatem carnis vestræ: sicut enim exhibuistis membra vestra servire immunditiæ, et iniquitati ad iniquitatem, ita nunc exhibete membra vestra servire justitiæ in santificationem.
tr: ανθρωπινον λεγω δια την ασθενειαν της σαρκος υμων ωσπερ γαρ παρεστησατε τα μελη υμων δουλα τη ακαθαρσια και τη ανομια εις την ανομιαν ουτως νυν παραστησατε τα μελη υμων δουλα τη δικαιοσυνη εις αγιασμον
kjv: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.

vulg: cum enim servi essetis peccati liberi fuistis iustitiae
clem: Cum enim servi essetis peccati, liberi fuistis justitiæ.
tr: οτε γαρ δουλοι ητε της αμαρτιας ελευθεροι ητε τη δικαιοσυνη
kjv: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.

vulg: quem ergo fructum habuistis tunc in quibus nunc erubescitis nam finis illorum mors est
clem: Quem ergo fructum habuistis tunc in illis, in quibus nunc erubescitis? nam finis illorum mors est.
tr: τινα ουν καρπον ειχετε τοτε εφ οις νυν επαισχυνεσθε το γαρ τελος εκεινων θανατος
kjv: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.

vulg: nunc vero liberati a peccato servi autem facti Deo habetis fructum vestrum in sanctificationem finem vero vitam aeternam
clem: Nunc vero liberati a peccato, servi autem facti Deo, habetis fructum vestrum in santificationem, finem vero vitam æternam.
tr: νυνι δε ελευθερωθεντες απο της αμαρτιας δουλωθεντες δε τω θεω εχετε τον καρπον υμων εις αγιασμον το δε τελος ζωην αιωνιον
kjv: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.

vulg: stipendia enim peccati mors gratia autem Dei vita aeterna in Christo Iesu Domino nostro
clem: Stipendia enim peccati, mors. Gratia autem Dei, vita æterna, in Christo Jesu Domino nostro.
tr: τα γαρ οψωνια της αμαρτιας θανατος το δε χαρισμα του θεου ζωη αιωνιος εν χριστω ιησου τω κυριω ημων
kjv: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

vulg: an ignoratis fratres scientibus enim legem loquor quia lex in homine dominatur quanto tempore vivit
clem: An ignoratis, fratres (scientibus enim legem loquor), quia lex in homine dominatur quanto tempore vivit?
tr: η αγνοειτε αδελφοι γινωσκουσιν γαρ νομον λαλω οτι ο νομος κυριευει του ανθρωπου εφ οσον χρονον ζη
kjv: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?

vulg: nam quae sub viro est mulier vivente viro alligata est legi si autem mortuus fuerit vir soluta est a lege viri
clem: Nam quæ sub viro est mulier, vivente viro, alligata est legi: si autem mortuus fuerit vir ejus, soluta est a lege viri.
tr: η γαρ υπανδρος γυνη τω ζωντι ανδρι δεδεται νομω εαν δε αποθανη ο ανηρ κατηργηται απο του νομου του ανδρος
kjv: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.

vulg: igitur vivente viro vocabitur adultera si fuerit cum alio viro si autem mortuus fuerit vir eius liberata est a lege ut non sit adultera si fuerit cum alio viro
clem: Igitur, vivente viro, vocabitur adultera si fuerit cum alio viro: si autem mortuus fuerit vir ejus, liberata est a lege viri, ut non sit adultera si fuerit cum alio viro.
tr: αρα ουν ζωντος του ανδρος μοιχαλις χρηματισει εαν γενηται ανδρι ετερω εαν δε αποθανη ο ανηρ ελευθερα εστιν απο του νομου του μη ειναι αυτην μοιχαλιδα γενομενην ανδρι ετερω
kjv: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.

vulg: itaque fratres mei et vos mortificati estis legi per corpus Christi ut sitis alterius qui ex mortuis resurrexit ut fructificaremus Deo
clem: Itaque fratres mei, et vos mortificati estis legi per corpus Christi: ut sitis alterius, qui ex mortuis resurrexit, ut fructificemus Deo.
tr: ωστε αδελφοι μου και υμεις εθανατωθητε τω νομω δια του σωματος του χριστου εις το γενεσθαι υμας ετερω τω εκ νεκρων εγερθεντι ινα καρποφορησωμεν τω θεω
kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.

vulg: cum enim essemus in carne passiones peccatorum quae per legem erant operabantur in membris nostris ut fructificarent morti
clem: Cum enim essemus in carne, passiones peccatorum, quæ per legem erant, operabantur in membris nostris, ut fructificarent morti.
tr: οτε γαρ ημεν εν τη σαρκι τα παθηματα των αμαρτιων τα δια του νομου ενηργειτο εν τοις μελεσιν ημων εις το καρποφορησαι τω θανατω
kjv: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.

vulg: nunc autem soluti sumus a lege morientes in quo detinebamur ita ut serviamus in novitate spiritus et non in vetustate litterae
clem: Nunc autem soluti sumus a lege mortis, in qua detinebamur, ita ut serviamus in novitate spiritus, et non in vetustate litteræ.
tr: νυνι δε κατηργηθημεν απο του νομου αποθανοντες  αποθανοντος  εν ω κατειχομεθα ωστε δουλευειν ημας εν καινοτητι πνευματος και ου παλαιοτητι γραμματος
kjv: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.

vulg: quid ergo dicemus lex peccatum est absit sed peccatum non cognovi nisi per legem nam concupiscentiam nesciebam nisi lex diceret non concupisces
clem: Quid ergo dicemus? lex peccatum est? Absit. Sed peccatum non cognovi, nisi per legem: nam concupiscentiam nesciebam, nisi lex diceret: Non concupisces.
tr: τι ουν ερουμεν ο νομος αμαρτια μη γενοιτο αλλα την αμαρτιαν ουκ εγνων ει μη δια νομου την τε γαρ επιθυμιαν ουκ ηδειν ει μη ο νομος ελεγεν ουκ επιθυμησεις
kjv: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.

vulg: occasione autem accepta peccatum per mandatum operatum est in me omnem concupiscentiam sine lege enim peccatum mortuum erat
clem: Occasione autem accepta, peccatum per mandatum operatum est in me omnem concupiscentiam. Sine lege enim peccatum mortuum erat.
tr: αφορμην δε λαβουσα η αμαρτια δια της εντολης κατειργασατο εν εμοι πασαν επιθυμιαν χωρις γαρ νομου αμαρτια νεκρα
kjv: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.

vulg: ego autem vivebam sine lege aliquando sed cum venisset mandatum peccatum revixit
clem: Ego autem vivebam sine lege aliquando: sed cum venisset mandatum, peccatum revixit.
tr: εγω δε εζων χωρις νομου ποτε ελθουσης δε της εντολης η αμαρτια ανεζησεν εγω δε απεθανον
kjv: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

vulg: ego autem mortuus sum et inventum est mihi mandatum quod erat ad vitam hoc esse ad mortem
clem: Ego autem mortuus sum: et inventum est mihi mandatum, quod erat ad vitam, hoc esse ad mortem.
tr: και ευρεθη μοι η εντολη η εις ζωην αυτη εις θανατον
kjv: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.

vulg: nam peccatum occasione accepta per mandatum seduxit me et per illud occidit
clem: Nam peccatum occasione accepta per mandatum, seduxit me, et per illud occidit.
tr: η γαρ αμαρτια αφορμην λαβουσα δια της εντολης εξηπατησεν με και δι αυτης απεκτεινεν
kjv: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.

vulg: itaque lex quidem sancta et mandatum sanctum et iustum et bonum
clem: Itaque lex quidem sancta, et mandatum sanctum, et justum, et bonum.
tr: ωστε ο μεν νομος αγιος και η εντολη αγια και δικαια και αγαθη
kjv: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.

vulg: quod ergo bonum est mihi factum est mors absit sed peccatum ut appareat peccatum per bonum mihi operatum est mortem ut fiat supra modum peccans peccatum per mandatum
clem: Quod ergo bonum est, mihi factum est mors? Absit. Sed peccatum, ut appareat peccatum, per bonum operatum est mihi mortem: ut fiat supra modum peccans peccatum per mandatum.
tr: το ουν αγαθον εμοι γεγονεν θανατος μη γενοιτο αλλα η αμαρτια ινα φανη αμαρτια δια του αγαθου μοι κατεργαζομενη θανατον ινα γενηται καθ υπερβολην αμαρτωλος η αμαρτια δια της εντολης
kjv: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.

vulg: scimus enim quod lex spiritalis est ego autem carnalis sum venundatus sub peccato
clem: Scimus enim quia lex spiritualis est: ego autem carnalis sum, venundatus sub peccato.
tr: οιδαμεν γαρ οτι ο νομος πνευματικος εστιν εγω δε σαρκικος ειμι πεπραμενος υπο την αμαρτιαν
kjv: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.

vulg: quod enim operor non intellego non enim quod volo hoc ago sed quod odi illud facio
clem: Quod enim operor, non intelligo: non enim quod volo bonum, hoc ago: sed quod odi malum, illud facio.
tr: ο γαρ κατεργαζομαι ου γινωσκω ου γαρ ο θελω τουτο πρασσω αλλ ο μισω τουτο ποιω
kjv: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.

vulg: si autem quod nolo illud facio consentio legi quoniam bona
clem: Si autem quod nolo, illud facio: consentio legi, quoniam bona est.
tr: ει δε ο ου θελω τουτο ποιω συμφημι τω νομω οτι καλος
kjv: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.

vulg: nunc autem iam non ego operor illud sed quod habitat in me peccatum
clem: Nunc autem jam non ego operor illud, sed quod habitat in me peccatum.
tr: νυνι δε ουκετι εγω κατεργαζομαι αυτο αλλ η οικουσα εν εμοι αμαρτια
kjv: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

vulg: scio enim quia non habitat in me hoc est in carne mea bonum nam velle adiacet mihi perficere autem bonum non invenio
clem: Scio enim quia non habitat in me, hoc est in carne mea, bonum. Nam velle, adjacet mihi: perficere autem bonum, non invenio.
tr: οιδα γαρ οτι ουκ οικει εν εμοι τουτ εστιν εν τη σαρκι μου αγαθον το γαρ θελειν παρακειται μοι το δε κατεργαζεσθαι το καλον ουχ ευρισκω
kjv: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.

vulg: non enim quod volo bonum hoc facio sed quod nolo malum hoc ago
clem: Non enim quod volo bonum, hoc facio: sed quod nolo malum, hoc ago.
tr: ου γαρ ο θελω ποιω αγαθον αλλ ο ου θελω κακον τουτο πρασσω
kjv: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.

vulg: si autem quod nolo illud facio non ego operor illud sed quod habitat in me peccatum
clem: Si autem quod nolo, illud facio: jam non ego operor illud, sed quod habitat in me, peccatum.
tr: ει δε ο ου θελω εγω τουτο ποιω ουκετι εγω κατεργαζομαι αυτο αλλ η οικουσα εν εμοι αμαρτια
kjv: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.

vulg: invenio igitur legem volenti mihi facere bonum quoniam mihi malum adiacet
clem: Invenio igitur legem, volenti mihi facere bonum, quoniam mihi malum adjacet:
tr: ευρισκω αρα τον νομον τω θελοντι εμοι ποιειν το καλον οτι εμοι το κακον παρακειται
kjv: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.

vulg: condelector enim legi Dei secundum interiorem hominem
clem: condelector enim legi Dei secundum interiorem hominem:
tr: συνηδομαι γαρ τω νομω του θεου κατα τον εσω ανθρωπον
kjv: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:

vulg: video autem aliam legem in membris meis repugnantem legi mentis meae et captivantem me in lege peccati quae est in membris meis
clem: video autem aliam legem in membris meis, repugnantem legi mentis meæ, et captivantem me in lege peccati, quæ est in membris meis.
tr: βλεπω δε ετερον νομον εν τοις μελεσιν μου αντιστρατευομενον τω νομω του νοος μου και αιχμαλωτιζοντα με τω νομω της αμαρτιας τω οντι εν τοις μελεσιν μου
kjv: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.

vulg: infelix ego homo quis me liberabit de corpore mortis huius
clem: Infelix ego homo, quis me liberabit de corpore mortis hujus?
