tr: ταλαιπωρος εγω ανθρωπος τις με ρυσεται εκ του σωματος του θανατου τουτου
kjv: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?

vulg: gratia Dei per Iesum Christum Dominum nostrum igitur ego ipse mente servio legi Dei carne autem legi peccati
clem: gratia Dei per Jesum Christum Dominum nostrum. Igitur ego ipse mente servio legi Dei: carne autem, legi peccati.
tr: ευχαριστω τω θεω δια ιησου χριστου του κυριου ημων αρα ουν αυτος εγω τω μεν νοι δουλευω νομω θεου τη δε σαρκι νομω αμαρτιας
kjv: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.

vulg: nihil ergo nunc damnationis est his qui sunt in Christo Iesu qui non secundum carnem ambulant
clem: Nihil ergo nunc damnationis est iis qui sunt in Christo Jesu: qui non secundum carnem ambulant.
tr: ουδεν αρα νυν κατακριμα τοις εν χριστω ιησου μη κατα σαρκα περιπατουσιν αλλα κατα πνευμα
kjv: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

vulg: lex enim Spiritus vitae in Christo Iesu liberavit me a lege peccati et mortis
clem: Lex enim spiritus vitæ in Christo Jesu liberavit me a lege peccati et mortis.
tr: ο γαρ νομος του πνευματος της ζωης εν χριστω ιησου ηλευθερωσεν με απο του νομου της αμαρτιας και του θανατου
kjv: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.

vulg: nam quod inpossibile erat legis in quo infirmabatur per carnem Deus Filium suum mittens in similitudinem carnis peccati et de peccato damnavit peccatum in carne
clem: Nam quod impossibile erat legi, in quo infirmabatur per carnem: Deus Filium suum mittens in similitudinem carnis peccati et de peccato, damnavit peccatum in carne,
tr: το γαρ αδυνατον του νομου εν ω ησθενει δια της σαρκος ο θεος τον εαυτου υιον πεμψας εν ομοιωματι σαρκος αμαρτιας και περι αμαρτιας κατεκρινεν την αμαρτιαν εν τη σαρκι
kjv: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:

vulg: ut iustificatio legis impleretur in nobis qui non secundum carnem ambulamus sed secundum Spiritum
clem: et justificatio legis impleretur in nobis, qui non secundum carnem ambulamus, sed secundum spiritum.
tr: ινα το δικαιωμα του νομου πληρωθη εν ημιν τοις μη κατα σαρκα περιπατουσιν αλλα κατα πνευμα
kjv: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

vulg: qui enim secundum carnem sunt quae carnis sunt sapiunt qui vero secundum Spiritum quae sunt Spiritus sentiunt
clem: Qui enim secundum carnem sunt, quæ carnis sunt, sapiunt: qui vero secundum spiritum sunt, quæ sunt spiritus, sentiunt.
tr: οι γαρ κατα σαρκα οντες τα της σαρκος φρονουσιν οι δε κατα πνευμα τα του πνευματος
kjv: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.

vulg: nam prudentia carnis mors prudentia autem Spiritus vita et pax
clem: Nam prudentia carnis, mors est: prudentia autem spiritus, vita et pax:
tr: το γαρ φρονημα της σαρκος θανατος το δε φρονημα του πνευματος ζωη και ειρηνη
kjv: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.

vulg: quoniam sapientia carnis inimicitia est in Deum legi enim Dei non subicitur nec enim potest
clem: quoniam sapientia carnis inimica est Deo: legi enim Dei non est subjecta, nec enim potest.
tr: διοτι το φρονημα της σαρκος εχθρα εις θεον τω γαρ νομω του θεου ουχ υποτασσεται ουδε γαρ δυναται
kjv: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.

vulg: qui autem in carne sunt Deo placere non possunt
clem: Qui autem in carne sunt, Deo placere non possunt.
tr: οι δε εν σαρκι οντες θεω αρεσαι ου δυνανται
kjv: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.

vulg: vos autem in carne non estis sed in Spiritu si tamen Spiritus Dei habitat in vobis si quis autem Spiritum Christi non habet hic non est eius
clem: Vos autem in carne non estis, sed in spiritu: si tamen Spiritus Dei habitat in vobis. Si quis autem Spiritum Christi non habet, hic non est ejus.
tr: υμεις δε ουκ εστε εν σαρκι αλλ εν πνευματι ειπερ πνευμα θεου οικει εν υμιν ει δε τις πνευμα χριστου ουκ εχει ουτος ουκ εστιν αυτου
kjv: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.

vulg: si autem Christus in vobis est corpus quidem mortuum est propter peccatum spiritus vero vita propter iustificationem
clem: Si autem Christus in vobis est, corpus quidem mortuum est propter peccatum, spiritus vero vivit propter justificationem.
tr: ει δε χριστος εν υμιν το μεν σωμα νεκρον δι αμαρτιαν το δε πνευμα ζωη δια δικαιοσυνην
kjv: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.

vulg: quod si Spiritus eius qui suscitavit Iesum a mortuis habitat in vobis qui suscitavit Iesum Christum a mortuis vivificabit et mortalia corpora vestra propter inhabitantem Spiritum eius in vobis
clem: Quod si Spiritus ejus, qui suscitavit Jesum a mortuis, habitat in vobis: qui suscitavit Jesum Christum a mortuis, vivificabit et mortalia corpora vestra, propter inhabitantem Spiritum ejus in vobis.
tr: ει δε το πνευμα του εγειραντος ιησουν εκ νεκρων οικει εν υμιν ο εγειρας τον χριστον εκ νεκρων ζωοποιησει και τα θνητα σωματα υμων δια το ενοικουν αυτου πνευμα  του ενοικουντος αυτου πνευματος  εν υμιν
kjv: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.

vulg: ergo fratres debitores sumus non carni ut secundum carnem vivamus
clem: Ergo fratres, debitores sumus non carni, ut secundum carnem vivamus.
tr: αρα ουν αδελφοι οφειλεται εσμεν ου τη σαρκι του κατα σαρκα ζην
kjv: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

vulg: si enim secundum carnem vixeritis moriemini si autem Spiritu facta carnis mortificatis vivetis
clem: Si enim secundum carnem vixeritis, moriemini: si autem spiritu facta carnis mortificaveritis, vivetis.
tr: ει γαρ κατα σαρκα ζητε μελλετε αποθνησκειν ει δε πνευματι τας πραξεις του σωματος θανατουτε ζησεσθε
kjv: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.

vulg: quicumque enim Spiritu Dei aguntur hii filii sunt Dei
clem: Quicumque enim Spiritu Dei aguntur, ii sunt filii Dei.
tr: οσοι γαρ πνευματι θεου αγονται ουτοι εισιν υιοι θεου
kjv: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.

vulg: non enim accepistis spiritum servitutis iterum in timore sed accepistis Spiritum adoptionis filiorum in quo clamamus Abba Pater
clem: Non enim accepistis spiritum servitutis iterum in timore, sed accepistis spiritum adoptionis filiorum, in quo clamamus: Abba (Pater).
tr: ου γαρ ελαβετε πνευμα δουλειας παλιν εις φοβον αλλ ελαβετε πνευμα υιοθεσιας εν ω κραζομεν αββα ο πατηρ
kjv: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.

vulg: ipse Spiritus testimonium reddit spiritui nostro quod sumus filii Dei
clem: Ipse enim Spiritus testimonium reddit spiritui nostro quod sumus filii Dei.
tr: αυτο το πνευμα συμμαρτυρει τω πνευματι ημων οτι εσμεν τεκνα θεου
kjv: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:

vulg: si autem filii et heredes heredes quidem Dei coheredes autem Christi si tamen conpatimur ut et conglorificemur
clem: Si autem filii, et hæredes: hæredes, quidem Dei, cohæredes autem Christi: si tamen compatimur ut et conglorificemur.
tr: ει δε τεκνα και κληρονομοι κληρονομοι μεν θεου συγκληρονομοι δε χριστου ειπερ συμπασχομεν ινα και συνδοξασθωμεν
kjv: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.

vulg: existimo enim quod non sunt condignae passiones huius temporis ad futuram gloriam quae revelabitur in nobis
clem: Existimo enim quod non sunt condignæ passiones hujus temporis ad futuram gloriam, quæ revelabitur in nobis.
tr: λογιζομαι γαρ οτι ουκ αξια τα παθηματα του νυν καιρου προς την μελλουσαν δοξαν αποκαλυφθηναι εις ημας
kjv: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.

vulg: nam expectatio creaturae revelationem filiorum Dei expectat
clem: Nam exspectatio creaturæ revelationem filiorum Dei exspectat.
tr: η γαρ αποκαραδοκια της κτισεως την αποκαλυψιν των υιων του θεου απεκδεχεται
kjv: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.

vulg: vanitati enim creatura subiecta est non volens sed propter eum qui subiecit in spem
clem: Vanitati enim creatura subjecta est non volens, sed propter eum, qui subjecit eam in spe:
tr: τη γαρ ματαιοτητι η κτισις υπεταγη ουχ εκουσα αλλα δια τον υποταξαντα επ ελπιδι
kjv: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,

vulg: quia et ipsa creatura liberabitur a servitute corruptionis in libertatem gloriae filiorum Dei
clem: quia et ipsa creatura liberabitur a servitute corruptionis in libertatem gloriæ filiorum Dei.
tr: οτι και αυτη η κτισις ελευθερωθησεται απο της δουλειας της φθορας εις την ελευθεριαν της δοξης των τεκνων του θεου
kjv: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.

vulg: scimus enim quod omnis creatura ingemescit et parturit usque adhuc
clem: Scimus enim quod omnis creatura ingemiscit, et parturit usque adhuc.
tr: οιδαμεν γαρ οτι πασα η κτισις συστεναζει και συνωδινει αχρι του νυν
kjv: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.

vulg: non solum autem illa sed et nos ipsi primitias Spiritus habentes et ipsi intra nos gemimus adoptionem filiorum expectantes redemptionem corporis nostri
clem: Non solum autem illa, sed et nos ipsi primitias spiritus habentes: et ipsi intra nos gemimus adoptionem filiorum Dei exspectantes, redemptionem corporis nostri.
tr: ου μονον δε αλλα και αυτοι την απαρχην του πνευματος εχοντες και ημεις αυτοι εν εαυτοις στεναζομεν υιοθεσιαν απεκδεχομενοι την απολυτρωσιν του σωματος ημων
kjv: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.

vulg: spe enim salvi facti sumus spes autem quae videtur non est spes nam quod videt quis quid sperat
clem: Spe enim salvi facti sumus. Spes autem, quæ videtur, non est spes: nam quod videt quis, quid sperat?
tr: τη γαρ ελπιδι εσωθημεν ελπις δε βλεπομενη ουκ εστιν ελπις ο γαρ βλεπει τις τι και ελπιζει
kjv: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?

vulg: si autem quod non videmus speramus per patientiam expectamus
clem: Si autem quod non videmus, speramus: per patientiam exspectamus.
tr: ει δε ο ου βλεπομεν ελπιζομεν δι υπομονης απεκδεχομεθα
kjv: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.

vulg: similiter autem et Spiritus adiuvat infirmitatem nostram nam quid oremus sicut oportet nescimus sed ipse Spiritus postulat pro nobis gemitibus inenarrabilibus
clem: Similiter autem et Spiritus adjuvat infirmitatem nostram: nam quid oremus, sicut oportet, nescimus: sed ipse Spiritus postulat pro nobis gemitibus inenarrabilibus.
tr: ωσαυτως δε και το πνευμα συναντιλαμβανεται ταις ασθενειαις ημων το γαρ τι προσευξωμεθα καθο δει ουκ οιδαμεν αλλ αυτο το πνευμα υπερεντυγχανει υπερ ημων στεναγμοις αλαλητοις
kjv: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.

vulg: qui autem scrutatur corda scit quid desideret Spiritus quia secundum Deum postulat pro sanctis
clem: Qui autem scrutatur corda, scit quid desideret Spiritus: quia secundum Deum postulat pro sanctis.
tr: ο δε ερευνων τας καρδιας οιδεν τι το φρονημα του πνευματος οτι κατα θεον εντυγχανει υπερ αγιων
kjv: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.

vulg: scimus autem quoniam diligentibus Deum omnia cooperantur in bonum his qui secundum propositum vocati sunt sancti
clem: Scimus autem quoniam diligentibus Deum omnia cooperantur in bonum, iis qui secundum propositum vocati sunt sancti.
tr: οιδαμεν δε οτι τοις αγαπωσιν τον θεον παντα  συνεργει εις αγαθον τοις κατα προθεσιν κλητοις ουσιν
kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.

vulg: nam quos praescivit et praedestinavit conformes fieri imaginis Filii eius ut sit ipse primogenitus in multis fratribus
clem: Nam quos præscivit, et prædestinavit conformes fieri imaginis Filii sui, ut sit ipse primogenitus in multis fratribus.
tr: οτι ους προεγνω και προωρισεν συμμορφους της εικονος του υιου αυτου εις το ειναι αυτον πρωτοτοκον εν πολλοις αδελφοις
kjv: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.

vulg: quos autem praedestinavit hos et vocavit et quos vocavit hos et iustificavit quos autem iustificavit illos et glorificavit
clem: Quos autem prædestinavit, hos et vocavit: et quos vocavit, hos et justificavit: quos autem justificavit, illos et glorificavit.
tr: ους δε προωρισεν τουτους και εκαλεσεν και ους εκαλεσεν τουτους και εδικαιωσεν ους δε εδικαιωσεν τουτους και εδοξασεν
kjv: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.

vulg: quid ergo dicemus ad haec si Deus pro nobis quis contra nos
clem: Quid ergo dicemus ad hæc? si Deus pro nobis, qui contra nos?
tr: τι ουν ερουμεν προς ταυτα ει ο θεος υπερ ημων τις καθ ημων
kjv: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?

vulg: qui etiam Filio suo non pepercit sed pro nobis omnibus tradidit illum quomodo non etiam cum illo omnia nobis donabit
clem: Qui etiam proprio Filio suo non pepercit, sed pro nobis omnibus tradidit illum: quomodo non etiam cum illo omnia nobis donavit?
tr: ος γε του ιδιου υιου ουκ εφεισατο αλλ υπερ ημων παντων παρεδωκεν αυτον πως ουχι και συν αυτω τα παντα ημιν χαρισεται
kjv: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?

vulg: quis accusabit adversus electos Dei Deus qui iustificat
clem: Quis accusabit adversus electos Dei? Deus qui justificat,
tr: τις εγκαλεσει κατα εκλεκτων θεου θεος ο δικαιων
kjv: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.

vulg: quis est qui condemnet Christus Iesus qui mortuus est immo qui resurrexit qui et est ad dexteram Dei qui etiam interpellat pro nobis
clem: quis est qui condemnet? Christus Jesus, qui mortuus est, immo qui et resurrexit, qui est ad dexteram Dei, qui etiam interpellat pro nobis.
tr: τις ο κατακρινων χριστος ο αποθανων μαλλον δε και εγερθεις ος και εστιν εν δεξια του θεου ος και εντυγχανει υπερ ημων
kjv: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.

vulg: quis nos separabit a caritate Christi tribulatio an angustia an persecutio an fames an nuditas an periculum an gladius
clem: Quis ergo nos separabit a caritate Christi? tribulatio? an angustia? an fames? an nuditas? an periculum? an persecutio? an gladius?
tr: τις ημας χωρισει απο της αγαπης του χριστου θλιψις η στενοχωρια η διωγμος η λιμος η γυμνοτης η κινδυνος η μαχαιρα
kjv: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

vulg: sicut scriptum est quia propter te mortificamur tota die aestimati sumus ut oves occisionis
clem: (Sicut scriptum est: [Quia propter te mortificamur tota die: æstimati sumus sicut oves occisionis.)]
tr: καθως γεγραπται οτι ενεκα σου θανατουμεθα ολην την ημεραν ελογισθημεν ως προβατα σφαγης
kjv: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.

vulg: sed in his omnibus superamus propter eum qui dilexit nos
clem: Sed in his omnibus superamus propter eum qui dilexit nos.
tr: αλλ εν τουτοις πασιν υπερνικωμεν δια του αγαπησαντος ημας
kjv: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.

vulg: certus sum enim quia neque mors neque vita neque angeli neque principatus neque instantia neque futura neque fortitudines
clem: Certus sum enim quia neque mors, neque vita, neque angeli, neque principatus, neque virtutes, neque instantia, neque futura, neque fortitudo,
tr: πεπεισμαι γαρ οτι ουτε θανατος ουτε ζωη ουτε αγγελοι ουτε αρχαι ουτε δυναμεις ουτε ενεστωτα ουτε μελλοντα
kjv: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,

vulg: neque altitudo neque profundum neque creatura alia poterit nos separare a caritate Dei quae est in Christo Iesu Domino nostro
clem: neque altitudo, neque profundum, neque creatura alia poterit nos separare a caritate Dei, quæ est in Christo Jesu Domino nostro.
tr: ουτε υψωμα ουτε βαθος ουτε τις κτισις ετερα δυνησεται ημας χωρισαι απο της αγαπης του θεου της εν χριστω ιησου τω κυριω ημων
kjv: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

vulg: veritatem dico in Christo non mentior testimonium mihi perhibente conscientia mea in Spiritu Sancto
clem: Veritatem dico in Christo, non mentior: testimonium mihi perhibente conscientia mea in Spiritu Sancto:
tr: αληθειαν λεγω εν χριστω ου ψευδομαι συμμαρτυρουσης μοι της συνειδησεως μου εν πνευματι αγιω
kjv: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,

vulg: quoniam tristitia est mihi magna et continuus dolor cordi meo
clem: quoniam tristitia mihi magna est, et continuus dolor cordi meo.
tr: οτι λυπη μοι εστιν μεγαλη και αδιαλειπτος οδυνη τη καρδια μου
kjv: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.

vulg: optabam enim ipse ego anathema esse a Christo pro fratribus meis qui sunt cognati mei secundum carnem
clem: Optabam enim ego ipse anathema esse a Christo pro fratribus meis, qui sunt cognati mei secundum carnem,
tr: ηυχομην γαρ αυτος εγω αναθεμα ειναι απο του χριστου υπερ των αδελφων μου των συγγενων μου κατα σαρκα
kjv: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:

vulg: qui sunt Israhelitae quorum adoptio est filiorum et gloria et testamenta et legislatio et obsequium et promissa
clem: qui sunt Israëlitæ, quorum adoptio est filiorum, et gloria, et testamentum, et legislatio, et obsequium, et promissa:
tr: οιτινες εισιν ισραηλιται ων η υιοθεσια και η δοξα και αι διαθηκαι και η νομοθεσια και η λατρεια και αι επαγγελιαι
kjv: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;

vulg: quorum patres et ex quibus Christus secundum carnem qui est super omnia Deus benedictus in saecula amen
clem: quorum patres, et ex quibus est Christus secundum carnem, qui est super omnia Deus benedictus in sæcula. Amen.
tr: ων οι πατερες και εξ ων ο χριστος το κατα σαρκα ο ων επι παντων θεος ευλογητος εις τους αιωνας αμην
kjv: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

vulg: non autem quod exciderit verbum Dei non enim omnes qui ex Israhel hii sunt Israhel
clem: Non autem quod exciderit verbum Dei. Non enim omnes qui ex Israël sunt, ii sunt Israëlitæ:
tr: ουχ οιον δε οτι εκπεπτωκεν ο λογος του θεου ου γαρ παντες οι εξ ισραηλ ουτοι ισραηλ
kjv: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:

vulg: neque quia semen sunt Abrahae omnes filii sed in Isaac vocabitur tibi semen
clem: neque qui semen sunt Abrahæ, omnes filii: sed in Isaac vocabitur tibi semen:
tr: ουδ οτι εισιν σπερμα αβρααμ παντες τεκνα αλλ εν ισαακ κληθησεται σοι σπερμα
kjv: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

vulg: id est non qui filii carnis hii filii Dei sed qui filii sunt promissionis aestimantur in semine
clem: id est, non qui filii carnis, hi filii Dei: sed qui filii sunt promissionis, æstimantur in semine.
tr: τουτ εστιν ου τα τεκνα της σαρκος ταυτα τεκνα του θεου αλλα τα τεκνα της επαγγελιας λογιζεται εις σπερμα
kjv: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

vulg: promissionis enim verbum hoc est secundum hoc tempus veniam et erit Sarrae filius
clem: Promissionis enim verbum hoc est: Secundum hoc tempus veniam: et erit Saræ filius.
tr: επαγγελιας γαρ ο λογος ουτος κατα τον καιρον τουτον ελευσομαι και εσται τη σαρρα υιος
kjv: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.

vulg: non solum autem sed et Rebecca ex uno concubitum habens Isaac patre nostro
clem: Non solum autem illa: sed et Rebecca ex uno concubitu habens, Isaac patris nostri.
tr: ου μονον δε αλλα και ρεβεκκα εξ ενος κοιτην εχουσα ισαακ του πατρος ημων
kjv: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;

vulg: cum enim nondum nati fuissent aut aliquid egissent bonum aut malum ut secundum electionem propositum Dei maneret
clem: Cum enim nondum nati fuissent, aut aliquid boni egissent, aut mali (ut secundum electionem propositum Dei maneret),
tr: μηπω γαρ γεννηθεντων μηδε πραξαντων τι αγαθον η κακον ινα η κατ εκλογην του θεου προθεσις μενη ουκ εξ εργων αλλ εκ του καλουντος
kjv: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)

vulg: non ex operibus sed ex vocante dictum est ei quia maior serviet minori
clem: non ex operibus, sed ex vocante dictum est ei quia major serviet minori,
tr: ερρηθη αυτη οτι ο μειζων δουλευσει τω ελασσονι
kjv: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.

vulg: sicut scriptum est Iacob dilexi Esau autem odio habui
clem: sicut scriptum est: Jacob dilexi, Esau autem odio habui.
tr: καθως γεγραπται τον ιακωβ ηγαπησα τον δε ησαυ εμισησα
kjv: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.

vulg: quid ergo dicemus numquid iniquitas apud Deum absit
clem: Quid ergo dicemus? numquid iniquitas apud Deum? Absit.
tr: τι ουν ερουμεν μη αδικια παρα τω θεω μη γενοιτο
kjv: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.

vulg: Mosi enim dicit miserebor cuius misereor et misericordiam praestabo cuius miserebor
clem: Moysi enim dicit: Miserebor cujus misereor: et misericordiam præstabo cujus miserebor.
tr: τω γαρ μωση λεγει ελεησω ον αν ελεω και οικτειρησω ον αν οικτειρω
kjv: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.

vulg: igitur non volentis neque currentis sed miserentis Dei
clem: Igitur non volentis, neque currentis, sed miserentis est Dei.
tr: αρα ουν ου του θελοντος ουδε του τρεχοντος αλλα του ελεουντος θεου
kjv: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.

vulg: dicit enim scriptura Pharaoni quia in hoc ipsum excitavi te ut ostendam in te virtutem meam et ut adnuntietur nomen meum in universa terra
clem: Dicit enim Scriptura Pharaoni: Quia in hoc ipsum excitavi te, ut ostendam in te virtutem meam: et ut annuntietur nomen meum in universa terra.
tr: λεγει γαρ η γραφη τω φαραω οτι εις αυτο τουτο εξηγειρα σε οπως ενδειξωμαι εν σοι την δυναμιν μου και οπως διαγγελη το ονομα μου εν παση τη γη
kjv: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.

vulg: ergo cuius vult miseretur et quem vult indurat
clem: Ergo cujus vult miseretur, et quem vult indurat.
tr: αρα ουν ον θελει ελεει ον δε θελει σκληρυνει
kjv: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.

vulg: dicis itaque mihi quid adhuc queritur voluntati enim eius quis resistit
clem: Dicis itaque mihi: Quid adhuc queritur? voluntati enim ejus quis resistit?
tr: ερεις ουν μοι τι ετι μεμφεται τω γαρ βουληματι αυτου τις ανθεστηκεν
kjv: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?

vulg: o homo tu quis es qui respondeas Deo numquid dicit figmentum ei qui se finxit quid me fecisti sic
clem: O homo, tu quis es, qui respondeas Deo? numquid dicit figmentum ei qui se finxit: Quid me fecisti sic?
tr: μενουνγε ω ανθρωπε συ τις ει ο ανταποκρινομενος τω θεω μη ερει το πλασμα τω πλασαντι τι με εποιησας ουτως
kjv: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?

vulg: an non habet potestatem figulus luti ex eadem massa facere aliud quidem vas in honorem aliud vero in contumeliam
clem: an non habet potestatem figulus luti ex eadem massa facere aliud quidem vas in honorem, aliud vero in contumeliam?
tr: η ουκ εχει εξουσιαν ο κεραμευς του πηλου εκ του αυτου φυραματος ποιησαι ο μεν εις τιμην σκευος ο δε εις ατιμιαν
kjv: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?

vulg: quod si volens Deus ostendere iram et notam facere potentiam suam sustinuit in multa patientia vasa irae aptata in interitum
clem: Quod si Deus volens ostendere iram, et notum facere potentiam suam, sustinuit in multa patientia vasa iræ, apta in interitum,
tr: ει δε θελων ο θεος ενδειξασθαι την οργην και γνωρισαι το δυνατον αυτου ηνεγκεν εν πολλη μακροθυμια σκευη οργης κατηρτισμενα εις απωλειαν
kjv: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:

vulg: ut ostenderet divitias gloriae suae in vasa misericordiae quae praeparavit in gloriam
clem: ut ostenderet divitias gloriæ suæ in vasa misericordiæ, quæ præparavit in gloriam.
tr: και ινα γνωριση τον πλουτον της δοξης αυτου επι σκευη ελεους α προητοιμασεν εις δοξαν
kjv: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,

vulg: quos et vocavit nos non solum ex Iudaeis sed etiam ex gentibus
clem: Quos et vocavit nos non solum ex Judæis, sed etiam in gentibus,
tr: ους και εκαλεσεν ημας ου μονον εξ ιουδαιων αλλα και εξ εθνων
kjv: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?

vulg: sicut in Osee dicit vocabo non plebem meam plebem meam et non misericordiam consecutam misericordiam consecutam
clem: sicut in Osee dicit: Vocabo non plebem meam, plebem meam: et non dilectam, dilectam: et non misericordiam consecutam, misericordiam consecutam.
tr: ως και εν τω ωσηε λεγει καλεσω τον ου λαον μου λαον μου και την ουκ ηγαπημενην ηγαπημενην
kjv: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.

vulg: et erit in loco ubi dictum est eis non plebs mea vos ibi vocabuntur filii Dei vivi
clem: Et erit: in loco, ubi dictum est eis: Non plebs mea vos: ibi vocabuntur filii Dei vivi.
tr: και εσται εν τω τοπω ου ερρηθη αυτοις ου λαος μου υμεις εκει κληθησονται υιοι θεου ζωντος
kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.

vulg: Esaias autem clamat pro Israhel si fuerit numerus filiorum Israhel tamquam harena maris reliquiae salvae fient
clem: Isaias autem clamat pro Israël: Si fuerit numerus filiorum Israël tamquam arena maris, reliquiæ salvæ fient.
tr: ησαιας δε κραζει υπερ του ισραηλ εαν η ο αριθμος των υιων ισραηλ ως η αμμος της θαλασσης το καταλειμμα σωθησεται
kjv: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

vulg: verbum enim consummans et brevians in aequitate quia verbum breviatum faciet Dominus super terram
clem: Verbum enim consummans, et abbrevians in æquitate: quia verbum breviatum faciet Dominus super terram:
tr: λογον γαρ συντελων και συντεμνων εν δικαιοσυνη οτι λογον συντετμημενον ποιησει κυριος επι της γης
kjv: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.

vulg: et sicut praedixit Esaias nisi Dominus Sabaoth reliquisset nobis semen sicut Sodoma facti essemus et sicut Gomorra similes fuissemus
clem: et sicut prædixit Isaias: Nisi Dominus Sabaoth reliquisset nobis semen, sicut Sodoma facti essemus, et sicut Gomorrha similes fuissemus.
tr: και καθως προειρηκεν ησαιας ει μη κυριος σαβαωθ εγκατελιπεν ημιν σπερμα ως σοδομα αν εγενηθημεν και ως γομορρα αν ωμοιωθημεν
kjv: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.

vulg: quid ergo dicemus quod gentes quae non sectabantur iustitiam adprehenderunt iustitiam iustitiam autem quae ex fide est
clem: Quid ergo dicemus? Quod gentes, quæ non sectabantur justitiam, apprehenderunt justitiam: justitiam autem, quæ ex fide est.
tr: τι ουν ερουμεν οτι εθνη τα μη διωκοντα δικαιοσυνην κατελαβεν δικαιοσυνην δικαιοσυνην δε την εκ πιστεως
kjv: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.

vulg: Israhel vero sectans legem iustitiae in legem iustitiae non pervenit
clem: Israël vero sectando legem justitiæ, in legem justitiæ non pervenit.
tr: ισραηλ δε διωκων νομον δικαιοσυνης εις νομον δικαιοσυνης ουκ εφθασεν
kjv: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.

vulg: quare quia non ex fide sed quasi ex operibus offenderunt in lapidem offensionis
clem: Quare? Quia non ex fide, sed quasi ex operibus: offenderunt enim in lapidem offensionis,
tr: δια τι οτι ουκ εκ πιστεως αλλ ως εξ εργων νομου προσεκοψαν γαρ τω λιθω του προσκομματος
kjv: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;

vulg: sicut scriptum est ecce pono in Sion lapidem offensionis et petram scandali et omnis qui credit in eum non confundetur
clem: sicut scriptum est: Ecce pono in Sion lapidem offensionis, et petram scandali: et omnis qui credit in eum, non confundetur.
tr: καθως γεγραπται ιδου τιθημι εν σιων λιθον προσκομματος και πετραν σκανδαλου και πας ο πιστευων επ αυτω ου καταισχυνθησεται
kjv: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

vulg: fratres voluntas quidem cordis mei et obsecratio ad Deum fit pro illis in salutem
clem: Fratres, voluntas quidem cordis mei, et obsecratio ad Deum, fit pro illis in salutem.
tr: αδελφοι η μεν ευδοκια της εμης καρδιας και η δεησις η προς τον θεον υπερ του ισραηλ εστιν εις σωτηριαν
kjv: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.

vulg: testimonium enim perhibeo illis quod aemulationem Dei habent sed non secundum scientiam
clem: Testimonium enim perhibeo illis quod æmulationem Dei habent, sed non secundum scientiam.
tr: μαρτυρω γαρ αυτοις οτι ζηλον θεου εχουσιν αλλ ου κατ επιγνωσιν
kjv: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.

vulg: ignorantes enim Dei iustitiam et suam quaerentes statuere iustitiae Dei non sunt subiecti
clem: Ignorantes enim justitiam Dei, et suam quærentes statuere, justitiæ Dei non sunt subjecti.
tr: αγνοουντες γαρ την του θεου δικαιοσυνην και την ιδιαν δικαιοσυνην ζητουντες στησαι τη δικαιοσυνη του θεου ουχ υπεταγησαν
kjv: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.

vulg: finis enim legis Christus ad iustitiam omni credenti
clem: Finis enim legis, Christus, ad justitiam omni credenti.
tr: τελος γαρ νομου χριστος εις δικαιοσυνην παντι τω πιστευοντι
kjv: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.

vulg: Moses enim scripsit quoniam iustitiam quae ex lege est qui fecerit homo vivet in ea
clem: Moyses enim scripsit, quoniam justitiam, quæ ex lege est, qui fecerit homo, vivet in ea.
tr: μωσης γαρ γραφει την δικαιοσυνην την εκ του νομου οτι ο ποιησας αυτα ανθρωπος ζησεται εν αυτοις
kjv: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.

vulg: quae autem ex fide est iustitia sic dicit ne dixeris in corde tuo quis ascendit in caelum id est Christum deducere
clem: Quæ autem ex fide est justitia, sic dicit: Ne dixeris in corde tuo: Qui ascendet in cælum? id est, Christum deducere:
tr: η δε εκ πιστεως δικαιοσυνη ουτως λεγει μη ειπης εν τη καρδια σου τις αναβησεται εις τον ουρανον τουτ εστιν χριστον καταγαγειν
kjv: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)

vulg: aut quis descendit in abyssum hoc est Christum ex mortuis revocare
clem: aut, Quis descendet in abyssum? hoc est, Christum a mortuis revocare.
tr: η τις καταβησεται εις την αβυσσον τουτ εστιν χριστον εκ νεκρων αναγαγειν
kjv: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)

vulg: sed quid dicit prope est verbum in ore tuo et in corde tuo hoc est verbum fidei quod praedicamus
clem: Sed quid dicit Scriptura? Prope est verbum in ore tuo, et in corde tuo: hoc est verbum fidei, quod prædicamus.
tr: αλλα τι λεγει εγγυς σου το ρημα εστιν εν τω στοματι σου και εν τη καρδια σου τουτ εστιν το ρημα της πιστεως ο κηρυσσομεν
kjv: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;

vulg: quia si confitearis in ore tuo Dominum Iesum et in corde tuo credideris quod Deus illum excitavit ex mortuis salvus eris
clem: Quia si confitearis in ore tuo Dominum Jesum, et in corde tuo credideris quod Deus illum suscitavit a mortuis, salvus eris.
tr: οτι εαν ομολογησης εν τω στοματι σου κυριον ιησουν και πιστευσης εν τη καρδια σου οτι ο θεος αυτον ηγειρεν εκ νεκρων σωθηση
kjv: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.

vulg: corde enim creditur ad iustitiam ore autem confessio fit in salutem
clem: Corde enim creditur ad justitiam: ore autem confessio fit ad salutem.
tr: καρδια γαρ πιστευεται εις δικαιοσυνην στοματι δε ομολογειται εις σωτηριαν
kjv: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.

vulg: dicit enim scriptura omnis qui credit in illum non confundetur
clem: Dicit enim Scriptura: Omnis qui credit in illum, non confundetur.
tr: λεγει γαρ η γραφη πας ο πιστευων επ αυτω ου καταισχυνθησεται
kjv: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.

vulg: non enim est distinctio Iudaei et Graeci nam idem Dominus omnium dives in omnes qui invocant illum
clem: Non enim est distinctio Judæi et Græci: nam idem Dominus omnium, dives in omnes qui invocant illum.
tr: ου γαρ εστιν διαστολη ιουδαιου τε και ελληνος ο γαρ αυτος κυριος παντων πλουτων εις παντας τους επικαλουμενους αυτον
kjv: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.

vulg: omnis enim quicumque invocaverit nomen Domini salvus erit
clem: Omnis enim quicumque invocaverit nomen Domini, salvus erit.
tr: πας γαρ ος αν επικαλεσηται το ονομα κυριου σωθησεται
kjv: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.

vulg: quomodo ergo invocabunt in quem non crediderunt aut quomodo credent ei quem non audierunt quomodo autem audient sine praedicante
clem: Quomodo ergo invocabunt, in quem non crediderunt? aut quomodo credent ei, quem non audierunt? quomodo autem audient sine prædicante?
tr: πως ουν επικαλεσονται εις ον ουκ επιστευσαν πως δε πιστευσουσιν ου ουκ ηκουσαν πως δε ακουσουσιν χωρις κηρυσσοντος
kjv: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?

vulg: quomodo vero praedicabunt nisi mittantur sicut scriptum est quam speciosi pedes evangelizantium pacem evangelizantium bona
clem: quomodo vero prædicabunt nisi mittantur? sicut scriptum est: Quam speciosi pedes evangelizantium pacem, evangelizantium bona!
tr: πως δε κηρυξουσιν εαν μη αποσταλωσιν καθως γεγραπται ως ωραιοι οι ποδες των ευαγγελιζομενων ειρηνην των ευαγγελιζομενων τα αγαθα
kjv: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!

vulg: sed non omnes oboedierunt evangelio Esaias enim dicit Domine quis credidit auditui nostro
clem: Sed non omnes obediunt Evangelio. Isaias enim dicit: Domine, quis credidit auditui nostro?
tr: αλλ ου παντες υπηκουσαν τω ευαγγελιω ησαιας γαρ λεγει κυριε τις επιστευσεν τη ακοη ημων
kjv: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?

vulg: ergo fides ex auditu auditus autem per verbum Christi
clem: Ergo fides ex auditu, auditus autem per verbum Christi.
tr: αρα η πιστις εξ ακοης η δε ακοη δια ρηματος θεου
kjv: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.

vulg: sed dico numquid non audierunt et quidem in omnem terram exiit sonus eorum et in fines orbis terrae verba eorum
clem: Sed dico: Numquid non audierunt? Et quidem in omnem terram exivit sonus eorum, et in fines orbis terræ verba eorum.
tr: αλλα λεγω μη ουκ ηκουσαν μενουνγε εις πασαν την γην εξηλθεν ο φθογγος αυτων και εις τα περατα της οικουμενης τα ρηματα αυτων
kjv: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.

vulg: sed dico numquid Israhel non cognovit primus Moses dicit ego ad aemulationem vos adducam in non gentem in gentem insipientem in iram vos mittam
clem: Sed dico: Numquid Israël non cognovit? Primus Moyses dicit: Ego ad æmulationem vos adducam in non gentem: in gentem insipientem, in iram vos mittam.
tr: αλλα λεγω μη ουκ εγνω ισραηλ πρωτος μωσης λεγει εγω παραζηλωσω υμας επ ουκ εθνει επι εθνει ασυνετω παροργιω υμας
kjv: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.

vulg: Esaias autem audet et dicit inventus sum non quaerentibus me palam apparui his qui me non interrogabant
clem: Isaias autem audet, et dicit: Inventus sum a non quærentibus me: palam apparui iis qui me non interrogabant.
tr: ησαιας δε αποτολμα και λεγει ευρεθην τοις εμε μη ζητουσιν εμφανης εγενομην τοις εμε μη επερωτωσιν
kjv: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.

vulg: ad Israhel autem dicit tota die expandi manus meas ad populum non credentem et contradicentem
clem: Ad Israël autem dicit: Tota die expandi manus meas ad populum non credentem, et contradicentem.
tr: προς δε τον ισραηλ λεγει ολην την ημεραν εξεπετασα τας χειρας μου προς λαον απειθουντα και αντιλεγοντα
kjv: But to Israel he saith, All day long I have stretched forth my hands unto a disobedient and gainsaying people.

vulg: dico ergo numquid reppulit Deus populum suum absit nam et ego Israhelita sum ex semine Abraham tribu Beniamin
clem: Dico ergo: Numquid Deus repulit populum suum? Absit. Nam et ego Israëlita sum ex semine Abraham, de tribu Benjamin:
tr: λεγω ουν μη απωσατο ο θεος τον λαον αυτου μη γενοιτο και γαρ εγω ισραηλιτης ειμι εκ σπερματος αβρααμ φυλης βενιαμιν
kjv: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.

vulg: non reppulit Deus plebem suam quam praesciit an nescitis in Helia quid dicit scriptura quemadmodum interpellat Deum adversus Israhel
clem: non repulit Deus plebem suam, quam præscivit. An nescitis in Elia quid dicit Scriptura? quemadmodum interpellat Deum adversum Israël:
tr: ουκ απωσατο ο θεος τον λαον αυτου ον προεγνω η ουκ οιδατε εν ηλια τι λεγει η γραφη ως εντυγχανει τω θεω κατα του ισραηλ λεγων
kjv: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel saying,

vulg: Domine prophetas tuos occiderunt altaria tua suffoderunt et ego relictus sum solus et quaerunt animam meam
clem: Domine, prophetas tuos occiderunt, altaria tua suffoderunt: et ego relictus sum solus, et quærunt animam meam.
tr: κυριε τους προφητας σου απεκτειναν και τα θυσιαστηρια σου κατεσκαψαν καγω υπελειφθην μονος και ζητουσιν την ψυχην μου
kjv: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.

vulg: sed quid dicit illi responsum divinum reliqui mihi septem milia virorum qui non curvaverunt genu Baal
clem: Sed quid dicit illi divinum responsum? Reliqui mihi septem millia virorum, qui non curvaverunt genua ante Baal.
tr: αλλα τι λεγει αυτω ο χρηματισμος κατελιπον εμαυτω επτακισχιλιους ανδρας οιτινες ουκ εκαμψαν γονυ τη βααλ
kjv: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.

vulg: sic ergo et in hoc tempore reliquiae secundum electionem gratiae factae sunt
clem: Sic ergo et in hoc tempore reliquiæ secundum electionem gratiæ salvæ factæ sunt.
tr: ουτως ουν και εν τω νυν καιρω λειμμα κατ εκλογην χαριτος γεγονεν
kjv: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.

vulg: si autem gratia non ex operibus alioquin gratia iam non est gratia
clem: Si autem gratia, jam non ex operibus: alioquin gratia jam non est gratia.
tr: ει δε χαριτι ουκετι εξ εργων επει η χαρις ουκετι γινεται χαρις ει δε εξ εργων ουκετι εστιν χαρις επει το εργον ουκετι εστιν εργον
kjv: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then it is no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.

vulg: quid ergo quod quaerebat Israhel hoc non est consecutus electio autem consecuta est ceteri vero excaecati sunt
clem: Quid ergo? Quod quærebat Israël, hoc non est consecutus: electio autem consecuta est: ceteri vero excæcati sunt:
tr: τι ουν ο επιζητει ισραηλ τουτου ουκ επετυχεν η δε εκλογη επετυχεν οι δε λοιποι επωρωθησαν
kjv: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded.

vulg: sicut scriptum est dedit illis Deus spiritum conpunctionis oculos ut non videant et aures ut non audiant usque in hodiernum diem
clem: sicut scriptum est: Dedit illis Deus spiritum compunctionis: oculos ut non videant, et aures ut non audiant, usque in hodiernum diem.
tr: καθως γεγραπται εδωκεν αυτοις ο θεος πνευμα κατανυξεως οφθαλμους του μη βλεπειν και ωτα του μη ακουειν εως της σημερον ημερας
kjv: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.

vulg: et David dicit fiat mensa eorum in laqueum et in captionem et in scandalum et in retributionem illis
clem: Et David dicit: Fiat mensa eorum in laqueum, et in captionem, et in scandalum, et in retributionem illis.
tr: και δαβιδ λεγει γενηθητω η τραπεζα αυτων εις παγιδα και εις θηραν και εις σκανδαλον και εις ανταποδομα αυτοις
kjv: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:

vulg: obscurentur oculi eorum ne videant et dorsum illorum semper incurva
clem: Obscurentur oculi eorum ne videant: et dorsum eorum semper incurva.
tr: σκοτισθητωσαν οι οφθαλμοι αυτων του μη βλεπειν και τον νωτον αυτων διαπαντος  δια παντος  συγκαμψον
kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.

vulg: dico ergo numquid sic offenderunt ut caderent absit sed illorum delicto salus gentibus ut illos aemulentur
clem: Dico ergo: Numquid sic offenderunt ut caderent? Absit. Sed illorum delicto, salus est gentibus ut illos æmulentur.
tr: λεγω ουν μη επταισαν ινα πεσωσιν μη γενοιτο αλλα τω αυτων παραπτωματι η σωτηρια τοις εθνεσιν εις το παραζηλωσαι αυτους
kjv: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.

vulg: quod si delictum illorum divitiae sunt mundi et deminutio eorum divitiae gentium quanto magis plenitudo eorum
clem: Quod si delictum illorum divitiæ sunt mundi, et diminutio eorum divitiæ gentium: quanto magis plenitudo eorum?
tr: ει δε το παραπτωμα αυτων πλουτος κοσμου και το ηττημα αυτων πλουτος εθνων ποσω μαλλον το πληρωμα αυτων
kjv: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?

vulg: vobis enim dico gentibus quamdiu quidem ego sum gentium apostolus ministerium meum honorificabo
clem: Vobis enim dico gentibus: Quamdiu quidem ego sum gentium Apostolus, ministerium meum honorificabo,
tr: υμιν γαρ λεγω τοις εθνεσιν εφ οσον μεν ειμι εγω εθνων αποστολος την διακονιαν μου δοξαζω
kjv: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:

vulg: si quo modo ad aemulandum provocem carnem meam et salvos faciam aliquos ex illis
clem: si quomodo ad æmulandum provocem carnem meam, et salvos faciam aliquos ex illis.
tr: ει πως παραζηλωσω μου την σαρκα και σωσω τινας εξ αυτων
kjv: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.

vulg: si enim amissio eorum reconciliatio est mundi quae adsumptio nisi vita ex mortuis
clem: Si enim amissio eorum, reconciliatio est mundi: quæ assumptio, nisi vita ex mortuis?
tr: ει γαρ η αποβολη αυτων καταλλαγη κοσμου τις η προσληψις ει μη ζωη εκ νεκρων
kjv: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?

vulg: quod si delibatio sancta est et massa et si radix sancta et rami
clem: Quod si delibatio sancta est, et massa: et si radix sancta, et rami.
tr: ει δε η απαρχη αγια και το φυραμα και ει η ριζα αγια και οι κλαδοι
kjv: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.

vulg: quod si aliqui ex ramis fracti sunt tu autem cum oleaster esses insertus es in illis et socius radicis et pinguidinis olivae factus es
clem: Quod si aliqui ex ramis fracti sunt, tu autem cum oleaster esses, insertus es in illis, et socius radicis, et pinguedinis olivæ factus es,
tr: ει δε τινες των κλαδων εξεκλασθησαν συ δε αγριελαιος ων ενεκεντρισθης εν αυτοις και συγκοινωνος της ριζης και της πιοτητος της ελαιας εγενου
kjv: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert grafted in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;

vulg: noli gloriari adversus ramos quod si gloriaris non tu radicem portas sed radix te
clem: noli gloriari adversus ramos. Quod si gloriaris: non tu radicem portas, sed radix te.
tr: μη κατακαυχω των κλαδων ει δε κατακαυχασαι ου συ την ριζαν βασταζεις αλλ η ριζα σε
kjv: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.

vulg: dices ergo fracti sunt rami ut ego inserar
clem: Dices ergo: Fracti sunt rami ut ego inserar.
tr: ερεις ουν εξεκλασθησαν οι κλαδοι ινα εγω εγκεντρισθω
kjv: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be grafted in.

vulg: bene propter incredulitatem fracti sunt tu autem fide stas noli altum sapere sed time
clem: Bene: propter incredulitatem fracti sunt. Tu autem fide stas: noli altum sapere, sed time.
tr: καλως τη απιστια εξεκλασθησαν συ δε τη πιστει εστηκας μη υψηλοφρονει αλλα φοβου
kjv: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:

vulg: si enim Deus naturalibus ramis non pepercit ne forte nec tibi parcat
clem: Si enim Deus naturalibus ramis non pepercit: ne forte nec tibi parcat.
tr: ει γαρ ο θεος των κατα φυσιν κλαδων ουκ εφεισατο μηπως ουδε σου φεισηται
kjv: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.

vulg: vide ergo bonitatem et severitatem Dei in eos quidem qui ceciderunt severitatem in te autem bonitatem Dei si permanseris in bonitate alioquin et tu excideris
clem: Vide ergo bonitatem, et severitatem Dei: in eos quidem qui ceciderunt, severitatem: in te autem bonitatem Dei, si permanseris in bonitate, alioquin et tu excideris.
tr: ιδε ουν χρηστοτητα και αποτομιαν θεου επι μεν τους πεσοντας αποτομιαν επι δε σε χρηστοτητα εαν επιμεινης τη χρηστοτητι επει και συ εκκοπηση
kjv: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.

vulg: sed et illi si non permanserint in incredulitate inserentur potens est enim Deus iterum inserere illos
clem: Sed et illi, si non permanserint in incredulitate, inserentur: potens est enim Deus iterum inserere illos.
tr: και εκεινοι δε εαν μη επιμεινωσιν τη απιστια εγκεντρισθησονται δυνατος γαρ εστιν ο θεος παλιν εγκεντρισαι αυτους
kjv: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be grafted in: for God is able to graft them in again.

vulg: nam si tu ex naturali excisus es oleastro et contra naturam insertus es in bonam olivam quanto magis hii secundum naturam inserentur suae olivae
clem: Nam si tu ex naturali excisus es oleastro, et contra naturam insertus es in bonam olivam: quanto magis ii qui secundum naturam inserentur suæ olivæ?
tr: ει γαρ συ εκ της κατα φυσιν εξεκοπης αγριελαιου και παρα φυσιν ενεκεντρισθης εις καλλιελαιον ποσω μαλλον ουτοι οι κατα φυσιν εγκεντρισθησονται τη ιδια ελαια
kjv: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert grafted contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be grafted into their own olive tree?

vulg: nolo enim vos ignorare fratres mysterium hoc ut non sitis vobis ipsis sapientes quia caecitas ex parte contigit in Israhel donec plenitudo gentium intraret
clem: Nolo enim vos ignorare, fratres, mysterium hoc (ut non sitis vobis ipsis sapientes), quia cæcitas ex parte contigit in Israël, donec plenitudo gentium intraret,
tr: ου γαρ θελω υμας αγνοειν αδελφοι το μυστηριον τουτο ινα μη ητε παρ εαυτοις φρονιμοι οτι πωρωσις απο μερους τω ισραηλ γεγονεν αχρις ου το πληρωμα των εθνων εισελθη
kjv: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.

vulg: et sic omnis Israhel salvus fieret sicut scriptum est veniet ex Sion qui eripiat avertet impietates ab Iacob
clem: et sic omnis Israël salvus fieret, sicut scriptum est: Veniet ex Sion, qui eripiat, et avertat impietatem a Jacob.
tr: και ουτως πας ισραηλ σωθησεται καθως γεγραπται ηξει εκ σιων ο ρυομενος και αποστρεψει ασεβειας απο ιακωβ
kjv: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:

vulg: et hoc illis a me testamentum cum abstulero peccata eorum
clem: Et hoc illis a me testamentum: cum abstulero peccata eorum.
tr: και αυτη αυτοις η παρ εμου διαθηκη οταν αφελωμαι τας αμαρτιας αυτων
kjv: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.

vulg: secundum evangelium quidem inimici propter vos secundum electionem autem carissimi propter patres
clem: Secundum Evangelium quidem, inimici propter vos: secundum electionem autem, carissimi propter patres.
tr: κατα μεν το ευαγγελιον εχθροι δι υμας κατα δε την εκλογην αγαπητοι δια τους πατερας
kjv: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the father's sakes.

vulg: sine paenitentia enim sunt dona et vocatio Dei
clem: Sine pœnitentia enim sunt dona et vocatio Dei.
tr: αμεταμελητα γαρ τα χαρισματα και η κλησις του θεου
kjv: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.

vulg: sicut enim aliquando et vos non credidistis Deo nunc autem misericordiam consecuti estis propter illorum incredulitatem
clem: Sicut enim aliquando et vos non credidistis Deo, nunc autem misericordiam consecuti estis propter incredulitatem illorum:
tr: ωσπερ γαρ και υμεις ποτε ηπειθησατε τω θεω νυν δε ηλεηθητε τη τουτων απειθεια
kjv: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:

vulg: ita et isti nunc non crediderunt in vestram misericordiam ut et ipsi misericordiam consequantur
clem: ita et isti nunc non crediderunt in vestram misericordiam: ut et ipsi misericordiam consequantur.
tr: ουτως και ουτοι νυν ηπειθησαν τω υμετερω ελεει ινα και αυτοι ελεηθωσιν
kjv: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.

vulg: conclusit enim Deus omnia in incredulitatem ut omnium misereatur
clem: Conclusit enim Deus omnia in incredulitate, ut omnium misereatur.
tr: συνεκλεισεν γαρ ο θεος τους παντας εις απειθειαν ινα τους παντας ελεηση
kjv: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.

vulg: o altitudo divitiarum sapientiae et scientiae Dei quam inconprehensibilia sunt iudicia eius et investigabiles viae eius
clem: O altitudo divitiarum sapientiæ, et scientiæ Dei: quam incomprehensibilia sunt judicia ejus, et investigabiles viæ ejus!
tr: ω βαθος πλουτου και σοφιας και γνωσεως θεου ως ανεξερευνητα τα κριματα αυτου και ανεξιχνιαστοι αι οδοι αυτου
kjv: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!

vulg: quis enim cognovit sensum Domini aut quis consiliarius eius fuit
clem: Quis enim cognovit sensum Domini? aut quis consiliarius ejus fuit?
tr: τις γαρ εγνω νουν κυριου η τις συμβουλος αυτου εγενετο
kjv: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?

vulg: aut quis prior dedit illi et retribuetur ei
clem: aut quis prior dedit illi, et retribuetur ei?
tr: η τις προεδωκεν αυτω και ανταποδοθησεται αυτω
kjv: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?

vulg: quoniam ex ipso et per ipsum et in ipso omnia ipsi gloria in saecula amen
clem: Quoniam ex ipso, et per ipsum, et in ipso sunt omnia: ipsi gloria in sæcula. Amen.
tr: οτι εξ αυτου και δι αυτου και εις αυτον τα παντα αυτω η δοξα εις τους αιωνας αμην
kjv: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.

vulg: obsecro itaque vos fratres per misericordiam Dei ut exhibeatis corpora vestra hostiam viventem sanctam Deo placentem rationabile obsequium vestrum
clem: Obsecro itaque vos fratres per misericordiam Dei, ut exhibeatis corpora vestra hostiam viventem, sanctam, Deo placentem, rationabile obsequium vestrum.
tr: παρακαλω ουν υμας αδελφοι δια των οικτιρμων του θεου παραστησαι τα σωματα υμων θυσιαν ζωσαν αγιαν ευαρεστον τω θεω την λογικην λατρειαν υμων
kjv: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.

vulg: et nolite conformari huic saeculo sed reformamini in novitate sensus vestri ut probetis quae sit voluntas Dei bona et placens et perfecta
clem: Et nolite conformari huic sæculo, sed reformamini in novitate sensus vestri: ut probetis quæ sit voluntas Dei bona, et beneplacens, et perfecta.
tr: και μη συσχηματιζεσθε τω αιωνι τουτω αλλα μεταμορφουσθε τη ανακαινωσει του νοος υμων εις το δοκιμαζειν υμας τι το θελημα του θεου το αγαθον και ευαρεστον και τελειον
kjv: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.

vulg: dico enim per gratiam quae data est mihi omnibus qui sunt inter vos non plus sapere quam oportet sapere sed sapere ad sobrietatem unicuique sicut Deus divisit mensuram fidei
clem: Dico enim per gratiam quæ data est mihi, omnibus qui sunt inter vos, non plus sapere quam oportet sapere, sed sapere ad sobrietatem: et unicuique sicut Deus divisit mensuram fidei.
tr: λεγω γαρ δια της χαριτος της δοθεισης μοι παντι τω οντι εν υμιν μη υπερφρονειν παρ ο δει φρονειν αλλα φρονειν εις το σωφρονειν εκαστω ως ο θεος εμερισεν μετρον πιστεως
kjv: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.

vulg: sicut enim in uno corpore multa membra habemus omnia autem membra non eundem actum habent
clem: Sicut enim in uno corpore multa membra habemus, omnia autem membra non eumdem actum habent:
tr: καθαπερ γαρ εν ενι σωματι μελη πολλα εχομεν τα δε μελη παντα ου την αυτην εχει πραξιν
kjv: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:

vulg: ita multi unum corpus sumus in Christo singuli autem alter alterius membra
clem: ita multi unum corpus sumus in Christo, singuli autem alter alterius membra.
tr: ουτως οι πολλοι εν σωμα εσμεν εν χριστω ο δε καθ εις αλληλων μελη
kjv: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.

vulg: habentes autem donationes secundum gratiam quae data est nobis differentes sive prophetiam secundum rationem fidei
clem: Habentes autem donationes secundum gratiam, quæ data est nobis, differentes: sive prophetiam secundum rationem fidei,
tr: εχοντες δε χαρισματα κατα την χαριν την δοθεισαν ημιν διαφορα ειτε προφητειαν κατα την αναλογιαν της πιστεως
kjv: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;

vulg: sive ministerium in ministrando sive qui docet in doctrina
clem: sive ministerium in ministrando, sive qui docet in doctrina,
tr: ειτε διακονιαν εν τη διακονια ειτε ο διδασκων εν τη διδασκαλια
kjv: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;

vulg: qui exhortatur in exhortando qui tribuit in simplicitate qui praeest in sollicitudine qui miseretur in hilaritate
clem: qui exhortatur in exhortando, qui tribuit in simplicitate, qui præest in sollicitudine, qui miseretur in hilaritate.
tr: ειτε ο παρακαλων εν τη παρακλησει ο μεταδιδους εν απλοτητι ο προισταμενος εν σπουδη ο ελεων εν ιλαροτητι
kjv: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.

vulg: dilectio sine simulatione odientes malum adherentes bono
clem: Dilectio sine simulatione: odientes malum, adhærentes bono:
tr: η αγαπη ανυποκριτος αποστυγουντες το πονηρον κολλωμενοι τω αγαθω
kjv: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.

vulg: caritatem fraternitatis invicem diligentes honore invicem praevenientes
clem: caritate fraternitatis invicem diligentes: honore invicem prævenientes:
tr: τη φιλαδελφια εις αλληλους φιλοστοργοι τη τιμη αλληλους προηγουμενοι
kjv: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;

vulg: sollicitudine non pigri spiritu ferventes Domino servientes
clem: sollicitudine non pigri: spiritu ferventes: Domino servientes:
tr: τη σπουδη μη οκνηροι τω πνευματι ζεοντες τω καιρω  κυριω  δουλευοντες
kjv: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

vulg: spe gaudentes in tribulatione patientes orationi instantes
clem: spe gaudentes: in tribulatione patientes: orationi instantes:
tr: τη ελπιδι χαιροντες τη θλιψει υπομενοντες τη προσευχη προσκαρτερουντες
kjv: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;

vulg: necessitatibus sanctorum communicantes hospitalitatem sectantes
clem: necessitatibus sanctorum communicantes: hospitalitatem sectantes.
tr: ταις χρειαις των αγιων κοινωνουντες την φιλοξενιαν διωκοντες
kjv: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.

vulg: benedicite persequentibus benedicite et nolite maledicere
clem: Benedicite persequentibus vos: benedicite, et nolite maledicere.
tr: ευλογειτε τους διωκοντας υμας ευλογειτε και μη καταρασθε
kjv: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.

vulg: gaudere cum gaudentibus flere cum flentibus
clem: Gaudere cum gaudentibus, flere cum flentibus:
tr: χαιρειν μετα χαιροντων και κλαιειν μετα κλαιοντων
kjv: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.

vulg: id ipsum invicem sentientes non alta sapientes sed humilibus consentientes nolite esse prudentes apud vosmet ipsos
clem: idipsum invicem sentientes: non alta sapientes, sed humilibus consentientes. Nolite esse prudentes apud vosmetipsos:
tr: το αυτο εις αλληλους φρονουντες μη τα υψηλα φρονουντες αλλα τοις ταπεινοις συναπαγομενοι μη γινεσθε φρονιμοι παρ εαυτοις
kjv: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.

vulg: nulli malum pro malo reddentes providentes bona non tantum coram Deo sed etiam coram omnibus hominibus
clem: nulli malum pro malo reddentes: providentes bona non tantum coram Deo, sed etiam coram omnibus hominibus.
tr: μηδενι κακον αντι κακου αποδιδοντες προνοουμενοι καλα ενωπιον παντων ανθρωπων
kjv: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.

vulg: si fieri potest quod ex vobis est cum omnibus hominibus pacem habentes
clem: Si fieri potest, quod ex vobis est, cum omnibus hominibus pacem habentes:
tr: ει δυνατον το εξ υμων μετα παντων ανθρωπων ειρηνευοντες
kjv: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.

vulg: non vosmet ipsos defendentes carissimi sed date locum irae scriptum est enim mihi vindictam ego retribuam dicit Dominus
clem: non vosmetipsos defendentes carissimi, sed date locum iræ. Scriptum est enim: Mihi vindicta: ego retribuam, dicit Dominus.
tr: μη εαυτους εκδικουντες αγαπητοι αλλα δοτε τοπον τη οργη γεγραπται γαρ εμοι εκδικησις εγω ανταποδωσω λεγει κυριος
kjv: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.

vulg: sed si esurierit inimicus tuus ciba illum si sitit potum da illi hoc enim faciens carbones ignis congeres super caput eius
clem: Sed si esurierit inimicus tuus, ciba illum: si sitit, potum da illi: hoc enim faciens, carbones ignis congeres super caput ejus.
tr: εαν ουν πεινα ο εχθρος σου ψωμιζε αυτον εαν διψα ποτιζε αυτον τουτο γαρ ποιων ανθρακας πυρος σωρευσεις επι την κεφαλην αυτου
kjv: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.

vulg: noli vinci a malo sed vince in bono malum
clem: Noli vinci a malo, sed vince in bono malum.
tr: μη νικω υπο του κακου αλλα νικα εν τω αγαθω το κακον
kjv: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.

vulg: omnis anima potestatibus sublimioribus subdita sit non est enim potestas nisi a Deo quae autem sunt a Deo ordinatae sunt
clem: Omnis anima potestatibus sublimioribus subdita sit: non est enim potestas nisi a Deo: quæ autem sunt, a Deo ordinatæ sunt.
tr: πασα ψυχη εξουσιαις υπερεχουσαις υποτασσεσθω ου γαρ εστιν εξουσια ει μη απο θεου αι δε ουσαι εξουσιαι υπο του θεου τεταγμεναι εισιν
kjv: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.

vulg: itaque qui resistit potestati Dei ordinationi resistit qui autem resistunt ipsi sibi damnationem adquirunt
clem: Itaque qui resistit potestati, Dei ordinationi resistit. Qui autem resistunt, ipsi sibi damnationem acquirunt:
tr: ωστε ο αντιτασσομενος τη εξουσια τη του θεου διαταγη ανθεστηκεν οι δε ανθεστηκοτες εαυτοις κριμα ληψονται
kjv: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.

vulg: nam principes non sunt timori boni operis sed mali vis autem non timere potestatem bonum fac et habebis laudem ex illa
clem: nam principes non sunt timori boni operis, sed mali. Vis autem non timere potestatem? Bonum fac: et habebis laudem ex illa:
tr: οι γαρ αρχοντες ουκ εισιν φοβος των αγαθων εργων αλλα των κακων θελεις δε μη φοβεισθαι την εξουσιαν το αγαθον ποιει και εξεις επαινον εξ αυτης
kjv: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:

vulg: Dei enim minister est tibi in bonum si autem male feceris time non enim sine causa gladium portat Dei enim minister est vindex in iram ei qui malum agit
clem: Dei enim minister est tibi in bonum. Si autem malum feceris, time: non enim sine causa gladium portat. Dei enim minister est: vindex in iram ei qui malum agit.
tr: θεου γαρ διακονος εστιν σοι εις το αγαθον εαν δε το κακον ποιης φοβου ου γαρ εικη την μαχαιραν φορει θεου γαρ διακονος εστιν εκδικος εις οργην τω το κακον πρασσοντι
kjv: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.

vulg: ideo necessitate subditi estote non solum propter iram sed et propter conscientiam
clem: Ideo necessitate subditi estote non solum propter iram, sed etiam propter conscientiam.
tr: διο αναγκη υποτασσεσθαι ου μονον δια την οργην αλλα και δια την συνειδησιν
kjv: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.

vulg: ideo enim et tributa praestatis ministri enim Dei sunt in hoc ipsum servientes
clem: Ideo enim et tributa præstatis: ministri enim Dei sunt, in hoc ipsum servientes.
tr: δια τουτο γαρ και φορους τελειτε λειτουργοι γαρ θεου εισιν εις αυτο τουτο προσκαρτερουντες
kjv: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.

vulg: reddite omnibus debita cui tributum tributum cui vectigal vectigal cui timorem timorem cui honorem honorem
clem: Reddite ergo omnibus debita: cui tribulatum, tributum: cui vectigal, vectigal: cui timorem, timorem: cui honorem, honorem.
tr: αποδοτε ουν πασιν τας οφειλας τω τον φορον τον φορον τω το τελος το τελος τω τον φοβον τον φοβον τω την τιμην την τιμην
kjv: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.

vulg: nemini quicquam debeatis nisi ut invicem diligatis qui enim diligit proximum legem implevit
clem: Nemini quidquam debeatis, nisi ut invicem diligatis: qui enim diligit proximum, legem implevit.
tr: μηδενι μηδεν οφειλετε ει μη το αγαπαν αλληλους ο γαρ αγαπων τον ετερον νομον πεπληρωκεν
kjv: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.

vulg: nam non adulterabis non occides non furaberis non concupisces et si quod est aliud mandatum in hoc verbo instauratur diliges proximum tuum tamquam te ipsum
clem: Nam: non adultaberis: non occides: non furaberis: non falsum testimonium dices: non concupisces: et si quod est aliud mandatum, in hoc verbo instauratur: diliges proximum tuum sicut teipsum.
tr: το γαρ ου μοιχευσεις ου φονευσεις ου κλεψεις ου ψευδομαρτυρησεις ουκ επιθυμησεις και ει τις ετερα εντολη εν τουτω τω λογω ανακεφαλαιουται εν τω αγαπησεις τον πλησιον σου ως εαυτον
kjv: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.

vulg: dilectio proximo malum non operatur plenitudo ergo legis est dilectio
clem: Dilectio proximi malum non operatur. Plenitudo ergo legis est dilectio.
tr: η αγαπη τω πλησιον κακον ουκ εργαζεται πληρωμα ουν νομου η αγαπη
kjv: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.

vulg: et hoc scientes tempus quia hora est iam nos de somno surgere nunc enim propior est nostra salus quam cum credidimus
clem: Et hoc scientes tempus: quia hora est jam nos de somno surgere. Nunc enim propior est nostra salus, quam cum credidimus.
tr: και τουτο ειδοτες τον καιρον οτι ωρα ημας ηδη εξ υπνου εγερθηναι νυν γαρ εγγυτερον ημων η σωτηρια η οτε επιστευσαμεν
kjv: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.

vulg: nox praecessit dies autem adpropiavit abiciamus ergo opera tenebrarum et induamur arma lucis
clem: Nox præcessit, dies autem appropinquavit. Abjiciamus ergo opera tenebrarum, et induamur arma lucis.
tr: η νυξ προεκοψεν η δε ημερα ηγγικεν αποθωμεθα ουν τα εργα του σκοτους και ενδυσωμεθα τα οπλα του φωτος
kjv: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.

vulg: sicut in die honeste ambulemus non in comesationibus et ebrietatibus non in cubilibus et inpudicitiis non in contentione et aemulatione
clem: Sicut in die honeste ambulemus: non in comessationibus, et ebrietatibus, non in cubilibus, et impudicitiis, non in contentione, et æmulatione:
tr: ως εν ημερα ευσχημονως περιπατησωμεν μη κωμοις και μεθαις μη κοιταις και ασελγειαις μη εριδι και ζηλω
kjv: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.

vulg: sed induite Dominum Iesum Christum et carnis curam ne feceritis in desideriis
clem: sed induamini Dominum Jesum Christum, et carnis curam ne feceritis in desideriis.
tr: αλλ ενδυσασθε τον κυριον ιησουν χριστον και της σαρκος προνοιαν μη ποιεισθε εις επιθυμιας
kjv: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.

vulg: infirmum autem in fide adsumite non in disceptationibus cogitationum
clem: Infirmum autem in fide assumite, non in disceptationibus cogitationum.
tr: τον δε ασθενουντα τη πιστει προσλαμβανεσθε μη εις διακρισεις διαλογισμων
kjv: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.

vulg: alius enim credit manducare omnia qui autem infirmus est holus manducat
clem: Alius enim credit se manducare omnia: qui autem infirmus est, olus manducet.
tr: ος μεν πιστευει φαγειν παντα ο δε ασθενων λαχανα εσθιει
kjv: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.

vulg: is qui manducat non manducantem non spernat et qui non manducat manducantem non iudicet Deus enim illum adsumpsit
clem: Is qui manducat, non manducantem non spernat: et qui non manducat, manducantem non judicet: Deus enim illum assumpsit.
tr: ο εσθιων τον μη εσθιοντα μη εξουθενειτω και ο μη εσθιων τον εσθιοντα μη κρινετω ο θεος γαρ αυτον προσελαβετο
kjv: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.

vulg: tu quis es qui iudices alienum servum suo domino stat aut cadit stabit autem potens est enim Deus statuere illum
clem: Tu quis es, qui judicas alienum servum? domino suo stat, aut cadit: stabit autem: potens est enim Deus statuere illum.
tr: συ τις ει ο κρινων αλλοτριον οικετην τω ιδιω κυριω στηκει η πιπτει σταθησεται δε δυνατος γαρ εστιν ο θεος στησαι αυτον
kjv: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.

vulg: nam alius iudicat diem plus inter diem alius iudicat omnem diem unusquisque in suo sensu abundet
clem: Nam alius judicat diem inter diem: alius autem judicat omnem diem: unusquisque in suo sensu abundet.
tr: ος μεν κρινει ημεραν παρ ημεραν ος δε κρινει πασαν ημεραν εκαστος εν τω ιδιω νοι πληροφορεισθω
kjv: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.

vulg: qui sapit diem Domino sapit et qui manducat Domino manducat gratias enim agit Deo et qui non manducat Domino non manducat et gratias agit Deo
clem: Qui sapit diem, Domino sapit, et qui manducat, Domino manducat: gratias enim agit Deo. Et qui non manducat, Domino non manducat, et gratias agit Deo.
tr: ο φρονων την ημεραν κυριω φρονει και ο μη φρονων την ημεραν κυριω ου φρονει ο εσθιων κυριω εσθιει ευχαριστει γαρ τω θεω και ο μη εσθιων κυριω ουκ εσθιει και ευχαριστει τω θεω
kjv: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.

vulg: nemo enim nostrum sibi vivit et nemo sibi moritur
clem: Nemo enim nostrum sibi vivit, et nemo sibi moritur.
tr: ουδεις γαρ ημων εαυτω ζη και ουδεις εαυτω αποθνησκει
kjv: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.

vulg: sive enim vivimus Domino vivimus sive morimur Domino morimur sive ergo vivimus sive morimur Domini sumus
clem: Sive enim vivemus, Domino vivimus: sive morimur, Domino morimur. Sive ergo vivimus, sive morimur, Domini sumus.
tr: εαν τε γαρ ζωμεν τω κυριω ζωμεν εαν τε αποθνησκωμεν τω κυριω αποθνησκομεν εαν τε ουν ζωμεν εαν τε αποθνησκωμεν του κυριου εσμεν
kjv: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.

vulg: in hoc enim Christus et mortuus est et revixit ut et mortuorum et vivorum dominetur
clem: In hoc enim Christus mortuus est, et resurrexit: ut et mortuorum et vivorum dominetur.
tr: εις τουτο γαρ χριστος και απεθανεν και ανεστη και ανεζησεν ινα και νεκρων και ζωντων κυριευση
kjv: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.

vulg: tu autem quid iudicas fratrem tuum aut tu quare spernis fratrem tuum omnes enim stabimus ante tribunal Dei
clem: Tu autem quid judicas fratrem tuum? aut tu quare spernis fratrem tuum? omnes enim stabimus ante tribunal Christi.
tr: συ δε τι κρινεις τον αδελφον σου η και συ τι εξουθενεις τον αδελφον σου παντες γαρ παραστησομεθα τω βηματι του χριστου
kjv: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

vulg: scriptum est enim vivo ego dicit Dominus quoniam mihi flectet omne genu et omnis lingua confitebitur Deo
clem: Scriptum est enim: Vivo ego, dicit Dominus, quoniam mihi flectetur omne genu: et omnis lingua confitebitur Deo.
tr: γεγραπται γαρ ζω εγω λεγει κυριος οτι εμοι καμψει παν γονυ και πασα γλωσσα εξομολογησεται τω θεω
kjv: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.

vulg: itaque unusquisque nostrum pro se rationem reddet Deo
clem: Itaque unusquisque nostrum pro se rationem reddet Deo.
tr: αρα ουν εκαστος ημων περι εαυτου λογον δωσει τω θεω
kjv: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.

vulg: non ergo amplius invicem iudicemus sed hoc iudicate magis ne ponatis offendiculum fratri vel scandalum
clem: Non ergo amplius invicem judicemus: sed hoc judicate magis, ne ponatis offendiculum fratri, vel scandalum.
tr: μηκετι ουν αλληλους κρινωμεν αλλα τουτο κρινατε μαλλον το μη τιθεναι προσκομμα τω αδελφω η σκανδαλον
kjv: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.

vulg: scio et confido in Domino Iesu quia nihil commune per ipsum nisi ei qui existimat quid commune esse illi commune est
clem: Scio, et confido in Domino Jesu, quia nihil commune per ipsum, nisi ei qui existimat quid commune esset, illi commune est.
tr: οιδα και πεπεισμαι εν κυριω ιησου οτι ουδεν κοινον δι εαυτου ει μη τω λογιζομενω τι κοινον ειναι εκεινω κοινον
kjv: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

vulg: si enim propter cibum frater tuus contristatur iam non secundum caritatem ambulas noli cibo tuo illum perdere pro quo Christus mortuus est
clem: Si enim propter cibum frater tuus contristatur, jam non secundum caritatem ambulas. Noli cibo tuo illum perdere, pro quo Christus mortuus est.
tr: ει δε δια βρωμα ο αδελφος σου λυπειται ουκετι κατα αγαπην περιπατεις μη τω βρωματι σου εκεινον απολλυε υπερ ου χριστος απεθανεν
kjv: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.

vulg: non ergo blasphemetur bonum nostrum
clem: Non ergo blasphemetur bonum nostrum.
tr: μη βλασφημεισθω ουν υμων το αγαθον
kjv: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:

vulg: non est regnum Dei esca et potus sed iustitia et pax et gaudium in Spiritu Sancto
clem: Non est enim regnum Dei esca et potus: sed justitia, et pax, et gaudium in Spiritu Sancto:
tr: ου γαρ εστιν η βασιλεια του θεου βρωσις και ποσις αλλα δικαιοσυνη και ειρηνη και χαρα εν πνευματι αγιω
kjv: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.

vulg: qui enim in hoc servit Christo placet Deo et probatus est hominibus
clem: qui enim in hoc servit Christo, placet Deo, et probatus est hominibus.
tr: ο γαρ εν τουτοις δουλευων τω χριστω ευαρεστος τω θεω και δοκιμος τοις ανθρωποις
kjv: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.

vulg: itaque quae pacis sunt sectemur et quae aedificationis sunt in invicem
clem: Itaque quæ pacis sunt, sectemur: et quæ ædificationis sunt, in invicem custodiamus.
tr: αρα ουν τα της ειρηνης διωκωμεν και τα της οικοδομης της εις αλληλους
kjv: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.

vulg: noli propter escam destruere opus Dei omnia quidem munda sunt sed malum est homini qui per offendiculum manducat
clem: Noli propter escam destruere opus Dei, omnia quidem sunt munda: sed malum est homini, qui per offendiculum manducat.
tr: μη ενεκεν βρωματος καταλυε το εργον του θεου παντα μεν καθαρα αλλα κακον τω ανθρωπω τω δια προσκομματος εσθιοντι
kjv: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
