vulg: bonum est non manducare carnem et non bibere vinum neque in quo frater tuus offendit aut scandalizatur aut infirmatur
clem: Bonum est non manducare carnem, et non bibere vinum, neque in quo frater tuus offenditur, aut scandalizatur, aut infirmatur.
tr: καλον το μη φαγειν κρεα μηδε πιειν οινον μηδε εν ω ο αδελφος σου προσκοπτει η σκανδαλιζεται η ασθενει
kjv: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.

vulg: tu fidem habes penes temet ipsum habe coram Deo beatus qui non iudicat semet ipsum in eo quo probat
clem: Tu fidem habes? penes temetipsum habe coram Deo. Beatus qui non judicat semetipsum in eo quod probat.
tr: συ πιστιν εχεις κατα σαυτον εχε ενωπιον του θεου μακαριος ο μη κρινων εαυτον εν ω δοκιμαζει
kjv: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.

vulg: qui autem discernit si manducaverit damnatus est quia non ex fide omne autem quod non ex fide peccatum est
clem: Qui autem discernit, si manducaverit, damnatus est: quia non ex fide. Omne autem, quod non est ex fide, peccatum est.
tr: ο δε διακρινομενος εαν φαγη κατακεκριται οτι ουκ εκ πιστεως παν δε ο ουκ εκ πιστεως αμαρτια εστιν
kjv: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.

vulg: debemus autem nos firmiores inbecillitates infirmorum sustinere et non nobis placere
clem: Debemus autem nos firmiores imbecillitates infirmorum sustinere, et non nobis placere.
tr: οφειλομεν δε ημεις οι δυνατοι τα ασθενηματα των αδυνατων βασταζειν και μη εαυτοις αρεσκειν
kjv: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

vulg: unusquisque vestrum proximo suo placeat in bonum ad aedificationem
clem: Unusquisque vestrum proximo suo placeat in bonum, ad ædificationem.
tr: εκαστος γαρ ημων τω πλησιον αρεσκετω εις το αγαθον προς οικοδομην
kjv: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.

vulg: etenim Christus non sibi placuit sed sicut scriptum est inproperia inproperantium tibi ceciderunt super me
clem: Etenim Christus non sibi placuit, sed sicut scriptum est: Improperia improperantium tibi ceciderunt super me.
tr: και γαρ ο χριστος ουχ εαυτω ηρεσεν αλλα καθως γεγραπται οι ονειδισμοι των ονειδιζοντων σε επεπεσον επ εμε
kjv: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.

vulg: quaecumque enim scripta sunt ad nostram doctrinam scripta sunt ut per patientiam et consolationem scripturarum spem habeamus
clem: Quæcumque enim scripta sunt, ad nostram doctrinam scripta sunt: ut per patientiam, et consolationem Scripturarum, spem habeamus.
tr: οσα γαρ προεγραφη εις την ημετεραν διδασκαλιαν προεγραφη ινα δια της υπομονης και της παρακλησεως των γραφων την ελπιδα εχωμεν
kjv: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.

vulg: Deus autem patientiae et solacii det vobis id ipsum sapere in alterutrum secundum Iesum Christum
clem: Deus autem patientiæ et solatii det vobis idipsum sapere in alterutrum secundum Jesum Christum:
tr: ο δε θεος της υπομονης και της παρακλησεως δωη υμιν το αυτο φρονειν εν αλληλοις κατα χριστον ιησουν
kjv: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:

vulg: ut unianimes uno ore honorificetis Deum et Patrem Domini nostri Iesu Christi
clem: ut unanimes, uno ore honorificetis Deum et patrem Domini nostri Jesu Christi.
tr: ινα ομοθυμαδον εν ενι στοματι δοξαζητε τον θεον και πατερα του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου
kjv: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

vulg: propter quod suscipite invicem sicut et Christus suscepit vos in honorem Dei
clem: Propter quod suscipite invicem, sicut et Christus suscepit vos in honorem Dei.
tr: διο προσλαμβανεσθε αλληλους καθως και ο χριστος προσελαβετο ημας εις δοξαν θεου
kjv: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.

vulg: dico enim Christum Iesum ministrum fuisse circumcisionis propter veritatem Dei ad confirmandas promissiones patrum
clem: Dico enim Christum Jesum ministrum fuisse circumcisionis propter veritatem Dei, ad confirmandas promissiones patrum:
tr: λεγω δε ιησουν χριστον διακονον γεγενησθαι περιτομης υπερ αληθειας θεου εις το βεβαιωσαι τας επαγγελιας των πατερων
kjv: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:

vulg: gentes autem super misericordiam honorare Deum sicut scriptum est propter hoc confitebor tibi in gentibus et nomini tuo cantabo
clem: gentes autem super misericordia honorare Deum, sicut scriptum est: Propterea confitebor tibi in gentibus, Domine, et nomini tuo cantabo.
tr: τα δε εθνη υπερ ελεους δοξασαι τον θεον καθως γεγραπται δια τουτο εξομολογησομαι σοι εν εθνεσιν και τω ονοματι σου ψαλω
kjv: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.

vulg: et iterum dicit laetamini gentes cum plebe eius
clem: Et iterum dicit: Lætamini gentes cum plebe ejus.
tr: και παλιν λεγει ευφρανθητε εθνη μετα του λαου αυτου
kjv: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.

vulg: et iterum laudate omnes gentes Dominum et magnificate eum omnes populi
clem: Et iterum: Laudate omnes gentes Dominum: et magnificate eum omnes populi.
tr: και παλιν αινειτε τον κυριον παντα τα εθνη και επαινεσατε αυτον παντες οι λαοι
kjv: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.

vulg: et rursus Esaias ait erit radix Iesse et qui exsurget regere gentes in eo gentes sperabunt
clem: Et rursus Isaias ait: Erit radix Jesse, et qui exsurget regere gentes, in eum gentes sperabunt.
tr: και παλιν ησαιας λεγει εσται η ριζα του ιεσσαι και ο ανισταμενος αρχειν εθνων επ αυτω εθνη ελπιουσιν
kjv: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.

vulg: Deus autem spei repleat vos omni gaudio et pace in credendo ut abundetis in spe in virtute Spiritus Sancti
clem: Deus autem spei repleat vos omni gaudio, et pace in credendo: ut abundetis in spe, et virtute Spiritus Sancti.
tr: ο δε θεος της ελπιδος πληρωσαι υμας πασης χαρας και ειρηνης εν τω πιστευειν εις το περισσευειν υμας εν τη ελπιδι εν δυναμει πνευματος αγιου
kjv: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.

vulg: certus sum autem fratres mei et ego ipse de vobis quoniam et ipsi pleni estis dilectione repleti omni scientia ita ut possitis alterutrum monere
clem: Certus sum autem fratres mei et ego ipse de vobis, quoniam et ipsi pleni estis dilectione, repleti omni scientia, ita ut possitis alterutrum monere.
tr: πεπεισμαι δε αδελφοι μου και αυτος εγω περι υμων οτι και αυτοι μεστοι εστε αγαθωσυνης πεπληρωμενοι πασης γνωσεως δυναμενοι και αλληλους νουθετειν
kjv: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.

vulg: audacius autem scripsi vobis fratres ex parte tamquam in memoriam vos reducens propter gratiam quae data est mihi a Deo
clem: Audacius autem scripsi vobis fratres ex parte, tamquam in memoriam vos reducens: propter gratiam, quæ data est mihi a Deo,
tr: τολμηροτερον δε εγραψα υμιν αδελφοι απο μερους ως επαναμιμνησκων υμας δια την χαριν την δοθεισαν μοι υπο του θεου
kjv: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,

vulg: ut sim minister Christi Iesu in gentibus sanctificans evangelium Dei ut fiat oblatio gentium accepta sanctificata in Spiritu Sancto
clem: ut sim minister Christi Jesu in gentibus: sanctificans Evangelium Dei, ut fiat oblatio gentium accepta, et sanctificata in Spiritu Sancto.
tr: εις το ειναι με λειτουργον ιησου χριστου εις τα εθνη ιερουργουντα το ευαγγελιον του θεου ινα γενηται η προσφορα των εθνων ευπροσδεκτος ηγιασμενη εν πνευματι αγιω
kjv: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.

vulg: habeo igitur gloriam in Christo Iesu ad Deum
clem: Habeo igitur gloriam in Christo Jesu ad Deum.
tr: εχω ουν καυχησιν εν χριστω ιησου τα προς θεον
kjv: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.

vulg: non enim audeo aliquid loqui eorum quae per me non effecit Christus in oboedientiam gentium verbo et factis
clem: Non enim audeo aliquid loqui eorum, quæ per me non efficit Christus in obedientiam gentium, verbo et factis:
tr: ου γαρ τολμησω λαλειν τι ων ου κατειργασατο χριστος δι εμου εις υπακοην εθνων λογω και εργω
kjv: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,

vulg: in virtute signorum et prodigiorum in virtute Spiritus Sancti ita ut ab Hierusalem per circuitum usque in Illyricum repleverim evangelium Christi
clem: in virtute signorum, et prodigiorum, in virtute Spiritus Sancti: ita ut ab Jerusalem per circuitum usque ad Illyricum repleverim Evangelium Christi.
tr: εν δυναμει σημειων και τερατων εν δυναμει πνευματος θεου ωστε με απο ιερουσαλημ και κυκλω μεχρι του ιλλυρικου πεπληρωκεναι το ευαγγελιον του χριστου
kjv: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.

vulg: sic autem hoc praedicavi evangelium non ubi nominatus est Christus ne super alienum fundamentum aedificarem
clem: Sic autem prædicavi Evangelium hoc, non ubi nominatus est Christus, ne super alienum fundamentum ædificarem:
tr: ουτως δε φιλοτιμουμενον ευαγγελιζεσθαι ουχ οπου ωνομασθη χριστος ινα μη επ αλλοτριον θεμελιον οικοδομω
kjv: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:

vulg: sed sicut scriptum est quibus non est adnuntiatum de eo videbunt et qui non audierunt intellegent
clem: sed sicut scriptum est: Quibus non est annuntiatum de eo, videbunt: et qui non audierunt, intelligent.
tr: αλλα καθως γεγραπται οις ουκ ανηγγελη περι αυτου οψονται και οι ουκ ακηκοασιν συνησουσιν
kjv: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.

vulg: propter quod et inpediebar plurimum venire ad vos
clem: Propter quod et impediebar plurimum venire ad vos, et prohibitus sum usque adhuc.
tr: διο και ενεκοπτομην τα πολλα του ελθειν προς υμας
kjv: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.

vulg: nunc vero ulterius locum non habens in his regionibus cupiditatem autem habens veniendi ad vos ex multis iam annis
clem: Nunc vero ulterius locum non habens in his regionibus, cupiditatem autem habens veniendi ad vos ex multis jam præcedentibus annis:
tr: νυνι δε μηκετι τοπον εχων εν τοις κλιμασιν τουτοις επιποθιαν δε εχων του ελθειν προς υμας απο πολλων ετων
kjv: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;

vulg: cum in Hispaniam proficisci coepero spero quod praeteriens videam vos et a vobis deducar illuc si vobis primum ex parte fruitus fuero
clem: cum in Hispaniam proficisci cœpero, spero quod præteriens videam vos, et a vobis deducar illuc, si vobis primum ex parte fruitus fuero.
tr: ως εαν πορευωμαι εις την σπανιαν ελευσομαι προς υμας ελπιζω γαρ διαπορευομενος θεασασθαι υμας και υφ υμων προπεμφθηναι εκει εαν υμων πρωτον απο μερους εμπλησθω
kjv: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.

vulg: nunc igitur proficiscar in Hierusalem ministrare sanctis
clem: Nunc igitur proficiscar in Jerusalem ministrare sanctis.
tr: νυνι δε πορευομαι εις ιερουσαλημ διακονων τοις αγιοις
kjv: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.

vulg: probaverunt enim Macedonia et Achaia conlationem aliquam facere in pauperes sanctorum qui sunt in Hierusalem
clem: Probaverunt enim Macedonia et Achaia collationem aliquam facere in pauperes sanctorum, qui sunt in Jerusalem.
tr: ευδοκησαν γαρ μακεδονια και αχαια κοινωνιαν τινα ποιησασθαι εις τους πτωχους των αγιων των εν ιερουσαλημ
kjv: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.

vulg: placuit enim eis et debitores sunt eorum nam si spiritalium eorum participes facti sunt gentiles debent et in carnalibus ministrare eis
clem: Placuit enim eis: et debitores sunt eorum. Nam si spiritualium eorum participes facti sunt gentiles, debent et in carnalibus ministrare illis.
tr: ευδοκησαν γαρ και οφειλεται αυτων εισιν ει γαρ τοις πνευματικοις αυτων εκοινωνησαν τα εθνη οφειλουσιν και εν τοις σαρκικοις λειτουργησαι αυτοις
kjv: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.

vulg: hoc igitur cum consummavero et adsignavero eis fructum hunc proficiscar per vos in Hispaniam
clem: Hoc igitur cum consummavero, et assignavero eis fructum hunc, per vos proficiscar in Hispaniam.
tr: τουτο ουν επιτελεσας και σφραγισαμενος αυτοις τον καρπον τουτον απελευσομαι δι υμων εις την σπανιαν
kjv: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.

vulg: scio autem quoniam veniens ad vos in abundantia benedictionis Christi veniam
clem: Scio autem quoniam veniens ad vos, in abundantia benedictionis Evangelii Christi veniam.
tr: οιδα δε οτι ερχομενος προς υμας εν πληρωματι ευλογιας του ευαγγελιου του χριστου ελευσομαι
kjv: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.

vulg: obsecro igitur vos fratres per Dominum nostrum Iesum Christum et per caritatem Spiritus ut adiuvetis me in orationibus pro me ad Deum
clem: Obsecro ergo vos fratres per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, et per caritatem Sancti Spiritus, ut adjuvetis me in orationibus vestris pro me ad Deum,
tr: παρακαλω δε υμας αδελφοι δια του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου και δια της αγαπης του πνευματος συναγωνισασθαι μοι εν ταις προσευχαις υπερ εμου προς τον θεον
kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;

vulg: ut liberer ab infidelibus qui sunt in Iudaea et obsequii mei oblatio accepta fiat in Hierosolyma sanctis
clem: ut liberer ab infidelibus, qui sunt in Judæa, et obsequii mei oblatio accepta fiat in Jerusalem sanctis,
tr: ινα ρυσθω απο των απειθουντων εν τη ιουδαια και ινα η διακονια μου η εις ιερουσαλημ ευπροσδεκτος γενηται τοις αγιοις
kjv: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;

vulg: ut veniam ad vos in gaudio per voluntatem Dei et refrigerer vobiscum
clem: ut veniam ad vos in gaudio per voluntatem Dei, et refrigerer vobiscum.
tr: ινα εν χαρα ελθω προς υμας δια θεληματος θεου και συναναπαυσωμαι υμιν
kjv: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.

vulg: Deus autem pacis sit cum omnibus vobis amen
clem: Deus autem pacis sit cum omnibus vobis. Amen.
tr: ο δε θεος της ειρηνης μετα παντων υμων αμην
kjv: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

vulg: commendo autem vobis Phoebem sororem nostram quae est in ministerio ecclesiae quae est Cenchris
clem: Commendo autem vobis Phœben sororem nostram, quæ est in ministerio ecclesiæ, quæ est in Cenchris:
tr: συνιστημι δε υμιν φοιβην την αδελφην ημων ουσαν διακονον της εκκλησιας της εν κεγχρεαις
kjv: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:

vulg: ut eam suscipiatis in Domino digne sanctis et adsistatis ei in quocumque negotio vestri indiguerit etenim ipsa quoque adstitit multis et mihi ipsi
clem: ut eam suscipiatis in Domino digne sanctis: et assistatis ei in quocumque negotio vestri indiguerit: etenim ipsa quoque astitit multis, et mihi ipsi.
tr: ινα αυτην προσδεξησθε εν κυριω αξιως των αγιων και παραστητε αυτη εν ω αν υμων χρηζη πραγματι και γαρ αυτη προστατις πολλων εγενηθη και αυτου εμου
kjv: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.

vulg: salutate Priscam et Aquilam adiutores meos in Christo Iesu
clem: Salutate Priscam et Aquilam, adjutores meos in Christo Jesu
tr: ασπασασθε πρισκιλλαν και ακυλαν τους συνεργους μου εν χριστω ιησου
kjv: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:

vulg: qui pro anima mea suas cervices subposuerunt quibus non solus ego gratias ago sed et cunctae ecclesiae gentium
clem: (qui pro anima mea suas cervices supposuerunt: quibus non solus ego gratias ago, sed et cunctæ ecclesiæ gentium),
tr: οιτινες υπερ της ψυχης μου τον εαυτων τραχηλον υπεθηκαν οις ουκ εγω μονος ευχαριστω αλλα και πασαι αι εκκλησιαι των εθνων
kjv: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.

vulg: et domesticam eorum ecclesiam salutate Ephaenetum dilectum mihi qui est primitivus Asiae in Christo
clem: et domesticam ecclesiam eorum. Salutate Epænetum dilectum mihi, qui est primitivus Asiæ in Christo.
tr: και την κατ οικον αυτων εκκλησιαν ασπασασθε επαινετον τον αγαπητον μου ος εστιν απαρχη της αχαιας εις χριστον
kjv: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my well-beloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.

vulg: salutate Mariam quae multum laboravit in vobis
clem: Salutate Mariam, quæ multum laboravit in vobis.
tr: ασπασασθε μαριαμ ητις πολλα εκοπιασεν εις ημας
kjv: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.

vulg: salutate Andronicum et Iuniam cognatos et concaptivos meos qui sunt nobiles in apostolis qui et ante me fuerunt in Christo
clem: Salutate Andronicum et Juniam, cognatos, et concaptivos meos: qui sunt nobiles in Apostolis, qui et ante me fuerunt in Christo.
tr: ασπασασθε ανδρονικον και ιουνιαν τους συγγενεις μου και συναιχμαλωτους μου οιτινες εισιν επισημοι εν τοις αποστολοις οι και προ εμου γεγονασιν εν χριστω
kjv: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.

vulg: salutate Ampliatum dilectissimum mihi in Domino
clem: Salutate Ampliatum dilectissimum mihi in Domino.
tr: ασπασασθε αμπλιαν τον αγαπητον μου εν κυριω
kjv: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.

vulg: salutate Urbanum adiutorem nostrum in Christo et Stachyn dilectum meum
clem: Salutate Urbanum adjutorem nostrum in Christo Jesu, et Stachyn dilectum meum.
tr: ασπασασθε ουρβανον τον συνεργον ημων εν χριστω και σταχυν τον αγαπητον μου
kjv: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.

vulg: salutate Apellen probum in Christo
clem: Salutate Apellen probum in Christo.
tr: ασπασασθε απελλην τον δοκιμον εν χριστω ασπασασθε τους εκ των αριστοβουλου
kjv: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.

vulg: salutate eos qui sunt ex Aristoboli salutate Herodionem cognatum meum salutate eos qui sunt ex Narcissi qui sunt in Domino
clem: Salutate eos qui sunt ex Aristoboli domo. Salutate Herodionem cognatum meum. Salutate eos qui sunt ex Narcisi domo, qui sunt in Domino.
tr: ασπασασθε ηροδιωνα τον συγγενη μου ασπασασθε τους εκ των ναρκισσου τους οντας εν κυριω
kjv: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.

vulg: salutate Tryfenam et Tryfosam quae laborant in Domino salutate Persidam carissimam quae multum laboravit in Domino
clem: Salutate Tryphænam et Tryphosam, quæ laborant in Domino. Salutate Persidem carissimam, quæ multum laboravit in Domino.
tr: ασπασασθε τρυφαιναν και τρυφωσαν τας κοπιωσας εν κυριω ασπασασθε περσιδα την αγαπητην ητις πολλα εκοπιασεν εν κυριω
kjv: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.

vulg: salutate Rufum electum in Domino et matrem eius et meam
clem: Salutate Rufum electum in Domino, et matrem ejus, et meam.
tr: ασπασασθε ρουφον τον εκλεκτον εν κυριω και την μητερα αυτου και εμου
kjv: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

vulg: salutate Asyncritum Flegonta Hermen Patrobam Hermam et qui cum eis sunt fratres
clem: Salutate Asyncritum, Phlegontem, Hermam, Patrobam, Hermen, et qui cum eis sunt, fratres.
tr: ασπασασθε ασυγκριτον φλεγοντα ερμαν πατροβαν ερμην και τους συν αυτοις αδελφους
kjv: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.

vulg: salutate Filologum et Iuliam Nereum et sororem eius et Olympiadem et omnes qui cum eis sunt sanctos
clem: Salutate Philologum et Juliam, Nereum, et sororem ejus, et Olympiadem, et omnes qui cum eis sunt, sanctos.
tr: ασπασασθε φιλολογον και ιουλιαν νηρεα και την αδελφην αυτου και ολυμπαν και τους συν αυτοις παντας αγιους
kjv: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.

vulg: salutate invicem in osculo sancto salutant vos omnes ecclesiae Christi
clem: Salutate invicem in osculo sancto. Salutant vos omnes ecclesiæ Christi.
tr: ασπασασθε αλληλους εν φιληματι αγιω ασπαζονται υμας αι εκκλησιαι του χριστου
kjv: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.

vulg: rogo autem vos fratres ut observetis eos qui dissensiones et offendicula praeter doctrinam quam vos didicistis faciunt et declinate ab illis
clem: Rogo autem vos fratres, ut observetis eos qui dissensiones et offendicula, præter doctrinam, quam vos didicistis, faciunt, et declinate ab illis.
tr: παρακαλω δε υμας αδελφοι σκοπειν τους τας διχοστασιας και τα σκανδαλα παρα την διδαχην ην υμεις εμαθετε ποιουντας και εκκλινατε απ αυτων
kjv: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.

vulg: huiusmodi enim Christo Domino nostro non serviunt sed suo ventri et per dulces sermones et benedictiones seducunt corda innocentium
clem: Hujuscemodi enim Christo Domino nostro non serviunt, sed suo ventri: et per dulces sermones et benedictiones seducunt corda innocentium.
tr: οι γαρ τοιουτοι τω κυριω ημων ιησου χριστω ου δουλευουσιν αλλα τη εαυτων κοιλια και δια της χρηστολογιας και ευλογιας εξαπατωσιν τας καρδιας των ακακων
kjv: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.

vulg: vestra enim oboedientia in omnem locum divulgata est gaudeo igitur in vobis sed volo vos sapientes esse in bono et simplices in malo
clem: Vestra enim obedientia in omnem locum divulgata est. Gaudeo igitur in vobis. Sed volo vos sapientes esse in bono, et simplices in malo.
tr: η γαρ υμων υπακοη εις παντας αφικετο χαιρω ουν το εφ υμιν θελω δε υμας σοφους μεν ειναι εις το αγαθον ακεραιους δε εις το κακον
kjv: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.

vulg: Deus autem pacis conteret Satanan sub pedibus vestris velociter gratia Domini nostri Iesu Christi vobiscum
clem: Deus autem pacis conterat Satanam sub pedibus vestris velociter. Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi vobiscum.
tr: ο δε θεος της ειρηνης συντριψει τον σαταναν υπο τους ποδας υμων εν ταχει η χαρις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μεθ υμων  αμην
kjv: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.

vulg: salutat vos Timotheus adiutor meus et Lucius et Iason et Sosipater cognati mei
clem: Salutat vos Timotheus adjutor meus, et Lucius, et Jason, et Sosipater cognati mei.
tr: ασπαζονται υμας τιμοθεος ο συνεργος μου και λουκιος και ιασων και σωσιπατρος οι συγγενεις μου
kjv: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.

vulg: saluto vos ego Tertius qui scripsi epistulam in Domino
clem: Saluto vos ego Tertius, qui scripsi epistolam, in Domino.
tr: ασπαζομαι υμας εγω τερτιος ο γραψας την επιστολην εν κυριω
kjv: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.

vulg: salutat vos Gaius hospes meus et universae ecclesiae salutat vos Erastus arcarius civitatis et Quartus frater
clem: Salutat vos Cajus hospes meus, et universa ecclesia. Salutat vos Erastus arcarius civitatis, et Quartus, frater.
tr: ασπαζεται υμας γαιος ο ξενος μου και της εκκλησιας ολης ασπαζεται υμας εραστος ο οικονομος της πολεως και κουαρτος ο αδελφος
kjv: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.

clem: Gratia Domini nostri Jesu Christi cum omnibus vobis. Amen.
tr: η χαρις του κυριου ημων ιησου χριστου μετα παντων υμων αμην
kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.

vulg: ei autem qui potens est vos confirmare iuxta evangelium meum et praedicationem Iesu Christi secundum revelationem mysterii temporibus aeternis taciti
clem: Ei autem, qui potens est vos confirmare juxta Evangelium meum, et prædicationem Jesu Christi, secundum revelationem mysterii temporibus æternis taciti
tr: τω δε δυναμενω υμας στηριξαι κατα το ευαγγελιον μου και το κηρυγμα ιησου χριστου κατα αποκαλυψιν μυστηριου χρονοις αιωνιοις σεσιγημενου
kjv: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,

vulg: quod nunc patefactum est per scripturas prophetarum secundum praeceptum aeterni Dei ad oboeditionem fidei in cunctis gentibus cognito
clem: (quod nunc patefactum est per Scripturas prophetarum secundum præceptum æterni Dei, ad obeditionem fidei), in cunctis gentibus cogniti,
tr: φανερωθεντος δε νυν δια τε γραφων προφητικων κατ επιταγην του αιωνιου θεου εις υπακοην πιστεως εις παντα τα εθνη γνωρισθεντος
kjv: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:

vulg: solo sapienti Deo per Iesum Christum cui honor in saecula saeculorum amen
clem: soli sapienti Deo, per Jesum Christum, cui honor et gloria in sæcula sæculorum. Amen.
tr: μονω σοφω θεω δια ιησου χριστου ω   η δοξα εις τους αιωνας αμην [ προς ρωμαιους εγραφη απο κορινθου δια φοιβης της διακονου της εν κεγχρεαις εκκλησιας]
kjv: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
